Naye kya mazima mu magezi nga bwe kiri mu bikolwa, nti lino, oluvannyuma lwa byonna, lye kkubo lyokka omwonoonyi mw’ayinza okufunira obuweerero. Singa Katonda yandigezezzaako okuwa abonoonyi obuweerero, n’okubalokola awatali kutoowaza malala gaabwe n’okubakyusa okuva mu bibi byabwe, teyandisobodde kukikola. Kaakano ekigendererwa ky’okuyigiriza omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu kisaanidde okuba okumukulembera mu kkubo erisinga obumpi nga bwe kisoboka okukola kino. Kwe kuleeta ebirowoozo bye, mu kkubo erisinga obumpi, ku kusalawo okw’omu bikolwa nti mu butuufu, tewali ngeri ndala gy’ayinza kufunamu buweerero n’okulokolebwa, okuggyako okwegaana yennyini n’awummulira mu Kristo yekka. Okukola kino mu ngeri ekola kyetaagisa obukugu bungi. Kyetaagisa okumanya mu bujjuvu omutima gw’omuntu, okutegeera okulambulukufu okw’enteekateeka y’obulokozi, n’endowooza entuufu era enkakafu ku kintu kyennyini omwonoonyi KY’ALINA OKUKOLA okulokolebwa. Okumanya engeri y’okukola kino mu ngeri ekola kye kimu ku bisaanyizo ebisinga okuba ebitono mu buweereza mu kiseera kino. Kinakuwaza okulaba nga ababuulizi batono, era nga abeeyita ba ddiini batono abalina mu birowoozo byabwe endowooza eyo ennambulukufu ku kintu ekirina okukolebwa, nti basobola okugenda eri omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu ne bamubuulira ddala ky’alina okukola, n’engeri y’okukikola, era ne basobola okumulaga mu lwatu nti tewali ngeri yonna ey’okulokolebwa okuggyako ng’akola ekintu ekyo kyennyini kye bamugamba, era ne basobola okumuleetera okuwulira obukakafu nti alina okukikola, era nti okuggyako ng’akola ekintu ekyo kyennyini, ajja kuzikirizibwa.

II. Nnina okulaga nti abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu bulijjo banoonya okubudaabudibwa.

Abonoonyi emirundi mingi balowooza nti banoonya Yesu Kristo, era banoonya eddiini, naye eno nsobi, Tewali muntu yali anoonyezza ddiini, n’asigala nga talina ddiini. Eddiini kye ki? Kwe kugondera Katonda. Okunoonya eddiini kwe kunoonya okugondera Katonda. Emmeeme erumwa enjala n’ennyonta olw’obutuukirivu y’emmeeme y’Omukristaayo. Okugamba nti omuntu asobola okunoonya okugondera Katonda, naye n’atamugondera, kya busirusiru. Kubanga bw’aba anoonya eddiini si mwonoonyi ateenenyezza. Okunoonya eddiini, kutegeeza okwetegeka okugondera Katonda, era okwetegeka okugondera Katonda kye kiri eddiini. Kiba kwekontanya okugamba nti omwonoonyi ateenenyezza anoonya eddiini. Kye kimu n’okugamba, nti anoonya era ddala ayagala nnyo okugondera Katonda, naye Katonda n’atamukkiriza, oba nti ayagala nnyo okwaniriza Yesu Kristo, naye Kristo n’atamukkiriza kujja. Ekituufu kiri nti, omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu anoonya ssuubi, anoonya okusonyiyibwa, n’okubudaabudibwa, n’okununulibwa okuva mu ggeyeena. Anoonya n’okweraliikirira omuntu ow’okumubudaabuda, n’okumuleetera okuwulira obulungi, awatali kuwalirizibwa kugondera bisaanyizo ebitoowaza ng’eby’Enjiri. Era okweraliikirira kwe n’obuyinike bwe byeyongera, kubanga kyokka tagondera bisaanyizo. Eky’ennaku, abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu basanga ababudaabuzi bangi abalinga bwe baagala. Ababudaabuzi ab’ennaku bonna nabo, “tewali kisigaddeyo ku bye baddamu wabula obulimba.” Tewali kubuusabuusa, obukadde n’obukadde kaakano bali mu ggeyeena, kubanga waaliwo abaabeetooloola abaabawa okubudaabudibwa okw’obulimba, abaali n’okusaasira okw’obulimba kungi bwe kutyo, oba bo bennyini nga bali mu kizikiza ennyo bwe batyo, nti tebandibalese kusigala mu kweraliikirira okutuusa lwe bandiwaddeyo emitima gyabwe eri Katonda, naye ne babawa obulimba, ne baggyawo obuyinike bwabwe mu ngeri eno, era kaakano emyoyo gyabwe gibuze.

III. Nnina okwogera ku ngeri eziwerako okubudaabuda okw’obulimba mwe kuweerwa abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu.

Nnandigambye kumpi, nti waliwo engeri ez’enjawulo ezitaggwaawo kino mwe kikolerwa. Gye nkoma okufuna obumanyirivu, era gye nkoma okwetegereza engeri n’abantu abalungi gye bakolaganamu n’abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu, gye nkoma okunakuwala olw’obusirusiru obutaggwaawo n’obulimba bwe bagezaako okubudaabuza mikwano gyabwe abeeraliikirivu, bwe batyo, mu butuufu, ne babalimba ne babasendasenda okuva ku bulokozi bwabwe. Emirundi mingi kinzijukiza engeri abantu gye beeyisaamu omuntu yenna bw’aba omulwadde. Omuntu yenna ku mmwe alwale, endwadde kumpi yonna mu nsi, era ojja kuzuula nti buli muntu gw’osisinkana alina eddagala ly’obulwadde obwo, obuwonyezo obukakafu, eddagala eryenjawulo, eddagala ly’endwadde zonna; era ojja kusanga ensi ey’obulimba bw’abasawo abatali ba mazima bwenkanidde awo okukwetooloola, nti bw’otofaayo ne OBUGAANA BWONNA, mazima ojja kufiirwa obulamu bwo. Omuntu alina okukozesa amagezi ge yekka, kubanga ajja kusanga eddagala lingi nga mikwano gye bwe giri, era buli omu yeekwata ku ddagala lye, era oboolyawo ajja kulowooza bubi bwe litakozesebwa. Era tewali kubuusabuusa enkola eno ey’ennaku ey’obulimba bw’abasawo abatali ba mazima etta abantu bangi nnyo.

Kino tekiri kya mazima nnyo ku ndwadde z’omubiri okusinga ku ndwadde z’ebirowoozo. Abantu balina eddagala lyabwe ery’enjawulo n’eddagala ly’endwadde zonna okubudaabuda emyoyo egiri mu buyinike, era buli lwe batandika okwogera n’omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu, bajja kuleeta okubudaabuda kwabwe okw’obulimba, okutuusa nti bw’ATEEGENDEREZA, n’afaayo ku kigambo kya Katonda, ajja kulimbibwa awatali kubuusabuusa okutuuka ku kuzikirira kwe. Ngenderera okwogera ku bumu ku bulimba obutera okuleetebwa mu kugezaako okubudaabuda abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu. Obudde bwandimpweddeko, ne mu kubwogera bwonna amannya.

Ekigendererwa eky’obutereevu eky’abantu bangi kwe kubudaabuda abonoonyi, era emirundi mingi bakyagala nnyo bwe batyo nti tebafaayo ku ngeri oba ekika ky’okubudaabudibwa. Balaba mikwano gyabwe nga bali mu buyinike, ne babasaasira, ne bawulira ekisa kingi, “Ayi, ayi, siyinza kugumira kubalaba nga bali mu buyinike bwe butyo, nnina okubabudaabuda mu ngeri emu,” era bwe batyo bagezaako engeri emu, n’endala, era byonna okubabudaabuda! Kaakano, Katonda ayagala babudaabudibwe. Wa kisa, era alina enneewulira ez’ekisa, n’omutima gwe gubalumirwa, bw’abalaba nga bali mu buyinike bwe butyo. Naye alaba nti waliwo engeri emu yokka ey’okuwa omwonoonyi okubudaabudibwa okw’amazima. Alina ekisa n’okusaasira okusinga abantu bonna, era ayagala okubabudaabuda. Naye ateeseteese ebisaanyizo, ebitakyuka ng’entebe ye ey’obwakabaka, by’anaawaako omwonoonyi obuweerero. Era tajja kukyusa. Amanyi nti tewali kirala kijja kukola mwonoonyi birungi bya mazima, kubanga tewali kiyinza kumusanyusa, okutuusa lw’ayenenya ebibi bye n’abireka, n’akyukira Katonda. Era n’olwekyo Katonda tajja kukkiriza. Ekigendererwa kyaffe kisaanidde okuba kye kimu n’ekya Katonda. Tusaanidde okuwulira okusaasira n’ekisa, nga ye bw’akola, era tubeere beetegefu okuwa okubudaabudibwa, naye tukakase nti kwa kika kituufu. Ekituufu kiri nti, ekigendererwa kyaffe ekikulu kisaanidde okuba okuleetera omwonoonyi okugondera Katonda. Okubudaabudibwa kwe kusaanidde okuba gye tuli, ne gy’ali, ekigendererwa eky’okubiri kyokka, era nga tweraliikirira nnyo okuggyawo obuyinike bwe okusinga okumulaba ng’alekedde awo okuvvoola, n’okunyooma Katonda, tekiyinzika nti, olw’okuyigiriza kwaffe, tujja kumukola kirungi kyonna kya mazima. Eno njawulo ya musingi, mu kukolagana n’abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu, naye mu lwatu ebuusibwa amaaso bangi, abalabika nga tebalina bigendererwa bya waggulu, okusinga okusaasira oba ekisa eri omwonoonyi. Bwe tuba nga mu kubuulira Enjiri, oba mu kuyigiriza abeeraliikirivu, tetukubirizibwa kufaayo kwa waggulu ku kitiibwa kya Katonda, ne tutasukka waggulu, okusinga okwagala okuggyawo obuyinike bw’abali mu buyinike; kino kiba kutuuka kyokka okusaasira okw’obutonde, oba ekisa, gye kwanditutuusizza. Okubuusa amaaso omusingi guno, emirundi mingi kukyamizza abeeyita ba ddiini, era bwe bawulidde abalala nga bakolagana n’obwesigwa n’abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu, babalumirizza obukambwe. Emirundi mingi abeeyita ba ddiini baandeetera abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu, ne banneegayirira mbabudaabude, era, bwe nnakebera emitima gyabwe egibalamula okutuuka mu buziba, ne bakankana, era oluusi ne bawagira oludda lw’abonoonyi. Oluusi tekisoboka kukolagana mu ngeri ekola n’abavubuka abeeraliikirivu, ng’abazadde baabwe weebali, kubanga balina okusaasira kungi nnyo eri abaana baabwe, okusinga okufaayo ku kitiibwa kya Katonda. Kino kyonna kikyamu, era n’endowooza n’enneewulira ng’ezo kyandisinze okusirika, okusinga okwogera ekintu kyonna eri abeeraliikirivu.

1. Emu ku ngeri abantu mwe bawa abonoonyi abali mu buyinike okubudaabudibwa okw’obulimba, kwe, kubabuuza nti “Okoze ki? toli mubi bw’otyo.” Babalaba nga bali mu buyinike, ne bakoowoola nti, “Lwaki, okoze ki?” ng’olinga tebaakolangako kintu kibi, era mu butuufu nga tebalina nsonga yonna ya kuwulira buyinike. Nnamala okwogera ku mbeera y’omukyala ow’omulembe, eyazuukusibwa mu kibuga kino, era eyali agenda okulaba omubuulizi okwogera naye, bwe yasisinkana mukwano gwe, n’amukyusa n’addayo, n’agoba okweraliikirira kwe, ng’akoowoola nti, “Okoze ki, okukuleetera okuwulira bw’otyo? Nkakasa nti tokolangako kibi kyonna, ekisaanira okukuleetera okuwulira bw’otyo.” Nzikiriza nti omuwandiisi w’ebyogerwa yabuuka embeera eno n’atagyogerako.

Emirundi mingi nsanze embeera ez’engeri eno. Maama ajja kubuulira mutabani we, omweraliikirivu, nga bw’abadde omwana omuwulize bulijjo, nga bw’abadde omulungi era ow’ekisa, era amwegayirira aleme kwennyamira bw’atyo. Bwe kityo omwami ajja kubuulira mukyala we, oba omukyala omwami we, nga bwe bali abalungi, era ne babuuza nti, “Okoze ki?” Bwe babalaba nga bali mu buyinike bungi, batandika okubabudaabuda nti, “Lwaki toli mubi bw’otyo. Ogenze okuwulira omubuulizi oyo ow’entiisa, atiisa abantu, n’osasamala. Buddaabudibwa, kubanga nkakasa nti tobadde mubi kimala okuwulira obuyinike bungi bwe butyo.” Ng’ate amazima gali nti, babadde babi nnyo okusinga bwe balowooza. Tewali mwonoonyi yali alowoozezza nti ebibi bye bisinga obunene bwe biri. Tewali mwonoonyi yali afunye ndowooza emala ku bunene bw’obwonoonyi bwe. Tekisuubirwa nti omuntu yenna yandisobodde okubeerawo ng’alaba mu bujjuvu ebibi bye. Katonda, mu kusaasira kwe, ayamuse ebitonde bye byonna ku nsi okulaba ekisinga obubi, omutima gw’omuntu omwereere. Omusango gw’omwonoonyi gwa buziba nnyo era gwa kuzikiriza okusinga bw’alowooza, n’akabi ke kanene nnyo okusinga bw’alowooza nti kali, era singa yandibirabye nga bwe biri, oboolyawo teyandibadde mulamu kaseera na kamu. Omwonoonyi ayinza okuba n’endowooza ezimu ez’obulimba ku nsonga eno, ezireeta obuyinike, ezitaliiko musingi. Ayinza okulowooza nti akoze ekibi ekitasonyiyibwa, oba nti anakuwazizza Omwoyo n’agenda, oba ayonoonye okutuusa olunaku lwe olw’ekisa lwe luyise. Naye okugamba omuntu asinga empisa ennungi n’obulungi obw’obutonde mu nsi nti mulungi ekimala, oba nti si mubi nga bw’alowooza, si kumuwa kubudaabudibwa okw’amagezi, wabula kumulimba, n’okuzikiriza emmeeme ye. Abo abakikola beegendereze.

2. Abalala bagamba abonoonyi abazuukusiddwa nti “Okukyuka mulimu ogugenda mpolampola,” era mu ngeri eno ne bakkakkanya okweraliikirira kwabwe. Omuntu bw’aba mu buyinike, kubanga yeerabye nga mwonoonyi bw’atyo, era nti okuggyako ng’akyukidde Katonda, ajja kuzikirizibwa; kiba buweerero bunene okubeera ne mukwano gwe ng’amuleetera endowooza nti asobola okulongooka mpolampola, era nti kaakano agenda ajja, kitono ku kitono, Bamugamba nti, “Lwaki tosobola kusuubira kutuuka omulundi gumu; sikkiriza mu kukyuka kuno okw’amangu, olina okulinda okuleka kikole, otandise bulungi, era mu bbanga ojja kufuna okubudaabudibwa.” Bino byonna bya bulimba ng’obunnya obutaliiko ntobo. Amazima gali nti, Okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri, oba okukyuka, si mulimu ogugenda mpolampola. Okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri kye ki? Kye ki okuggyako entandikwa y’okugondera Katonda? Era entandikwa y’ekintu egenda mpolampola? Kye kikolwa ekisooka eky’okugondera Katonda okw’amazima—ekikolwa ekisooka eky’obwagazi eky’ebirowoozo Katonda ky’asiima, oba ekiyinza okutwalibwa ng’okugondera Katonda. Okwo kwe kukyuka. Abantu bwe boogera ku kukyuka ng’omulimu ogugenda mpolampola, kya busirusiru. Balaga nti bamanyi ku kuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri oba okukyuka, kyenkana Nikodemu kye yamanya. Tebamanyi kintu ku kwo, nga bwe basaanidde okumanya, era tebasaanira kukulembera lukuŋŋaana lwa beeraliikirivu, oba okuwabula oba okuyigiriza abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu, okusinga Nikodemu bwe yali.

3. Engeri endala abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu mwe balimbibwa n’okubudaabuda okw’obulimba, kwe kuwabulwa okuleka ensonga mu kiseera kino.

Abantu abalowoozebwa okuba ab’amagezi era abalungi, beefudde ab’amagezi okusinga Katonda bwe batyo, nti Katonda bw’aba akolagana n’omwonoonyi, olw’Omwoyo we, era ng’agezaako okumuleeta ku kusalawo okw’amangu; balowooza nti Katonda anyigiriza nnyo, era nti kyetaagisa bo okuyingira mu nsonga; era bajja kuwabula omuntu agende atambuleko, oba agende mu banne, oba yenyigire mu mirimu, oba ekintu ekinaawummuza ebirowoozo bye katono, waakiri mu kiseera kino. Bandisobodde okugamba Katonda, mu bigambo ebyangu, nti “Ayi Katonda, oli mukakanyavu nnyo, oyanguyiriza nnyo, ojja kumugwiza eddalu, oba okumutta, tasobola kukigumira; ekitonde eky’ennaku, bw’anaanyigirizibwa bw’atyo, ajja kufa.” Bwe batyo bawagira oludda luwakanya Katonda, ne bakola kye kimu n’okugamba omwonoonyi yennyini nti, “Katonda ajja kukugwiza eddalu bw’otoleka nsonga, n’oziyiza Omwoyo, n’omugoba mu birowoozo byo.”

Okuwabula ng’okwo, bwe kuba nga ddala kusalirwa musango olw’ekibi okuleeta obuyinike eri omwonoonyi, mu mbeera yonna tekuliimu bukuumi wadde okuba okw’amateeka. Okufuba kw’Omwoyo, okuleeta omwonoonyi okudda mu magezi ge, tekulimukosa, wadde okumugwiza eddalu. Ayinza okwegwiza eddalu olw’okuziyiza, naye kuvvoola, okulowooza, nti Omwoyo wa Katonda ow’omukisa, ow’amagezi era ow’ekisa, yandyeyisizza n’obwegendereza obutono bwe butyo, okugwiza eddalu n’okuzikiriza emmeeme gye yajja okutukuza n’okulokola. Ekkubo ettuufu ery’okukwata n’omwonoonyi, okufuba kw’Omwoyo bwe kumusuula mu buyinike, kwe, kumuyigiriza, okulongoosa endowooza ze, okutereeza ensobi ze, n’okufuula ekkubo ly’obulokozi ennyangu bwe lityo nti asobola okulirabira ddala mu maaso ge. Si kuleka nsonga, wabula okukwatagana n’Omwoyo, bwe kityo n’okusirisa obulumi bwonna obw’entiisa obuleetebwa okuziyiza Mwoyo Mutukuvu. MUJJUKIRE, omwonoonyi azuukusiddwa bw’aleka ensonga ku bwagazi bwe omulundi gumu, oboolyawo talikwata nate.

4. Oluusi omwonoonyi azuukusiddwa abudaabudibwa ng’abuulirwa nti eddiini teri mu kuwulira bubi. Lumu nnawulira ku Musawo ow’Eby’Eddiini, ng’awa omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu okuwabula ng’okwo, nga ddala yeenyoola wansi w’obusaale bw’Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna. Yagamba nti, “Eddiini ya ssanyu, eddiini si ya nnaku, toba mu buyinike, buddaabudibwa, goba okutya kwo, tosaanye kuwulira bubi bw’otyo,” n’okubudaabuda okw’ennaku ng’okwo, ng’ate, mu butuufu, omusajja yalina ensonga etaliiko kkomo ey’okubeera mu buyinike, kubanga yali aziyiza Mwoyo Mutukuvu, era nga ali mu kabi ak’okumunakuwaza n’agenda emirembe gyonna.

Kya mazima, eddiini teri mu kuwulira bubi. Naye omwonoonyi alina ensonga okubeera mu buyinike, kubanga talina ddiini. Singa yalina eddiini, teyandiwulidde bw’atyo. Singa yali Mukristaayo, yandisanyuse. Naye okugamba omwonoonyi ateenenyezza okusanyuka! lwaki, wandisobodde okubuulira enjigiriza eno mu ggeyeena, n’ogamba abaliyo nti, “Musanyuke wano, musanyuke, temuwulira bubi bwe mutyo.”

Omwonoonyi ali ku mabbali ddala ga ggeyeena, ali mu bujeemu eri Katonda, n’akabi ke kanene nnyo mu ngeri etaliiko kkomo okusinga bw’alowooza. Ayi, nga njigiriza ya baddayimooni! okugamba omujeemu eri eggulu aleme kuba mu buyinike. Obuyinike bwe bwonna kye ki okuggyako obujeemu bwennyini? Tabudaabudibwa, kubanga agaana okubudaabudibwa. Katonda mwetegefu okumubudaabuda. Tosaanye kulowooza kuba wa kisa okusinga Katonda. Ajja kumujjuza okubudaabudibwa, mu kaseera katono, bw’anaagonda. Naye ayimiridde awo, ng’alwanagana ne Katonda, n’okuwakanya Mwoyo Mutukuvu, n’okuwakanya omutima gwe ogumulamula, okutuusa lw’aba mu buyinike kumpi okufa, era naye tagonda; era kaakano omuntu omu n’ayingira, “Ayi, nkyawa okukulaba ng’owulira bubi bw’otyo, toba mu buyinike bw’otyo, sanyuka, sanyuka, eddiini teri mu kubeera mu nnaku, buddaabudibwa.” Kya ntiisa!

5. Kyonna ekizingira ensonga y’eddiini mu kyama, kiteekeddwateekeddwa okuwa omwonoonyi okubudaabudibwa okw’obulimba.

Omwonoonyi bw’aba omweraliikirivu ku nsonga y’eddiini, emirundi mingi, bw’ogizingira mu kyama, ajja kuwulira ng’awummudde. Obuyinike bw’omwonoonyi buva mu kunyigirizibwa obuvunaanyizibwa obuliwo kaakano. Mumulise ku nsonga eno, ogitangaaze, era bw’atagonda, kijja kwongera bwongezi ku buyinike bwe. Naye mugambe nti okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri kyama kyokka, ekintu ky’atayinza kutegeera; omuleke wonna mu kifu ky’ekizikiza, era oba omuwummuzizza okweraliikirira kwe. Endowooza ye ennambulukufu ku butonde n’omulimu gw’okwenenya, ye ereeta obuyinike bwe. Kye kitangaala ekireeta obulumi mu birowoozo bye, ng’agaana okugonda. Kye kyo, ekirikola obulumi bwa ggeyeena. Era kijja kumpi okukola ggeyeena mu kifuba ky’omwonoonyi wano, singa kifuulibwa kyokka ekitangaavu ekimala. Naye bikka bubisi ekitangaala kino, era okweraliikirira kwe kujja amangu ddala okukendeera ennyo mu bukambwe n’okukankanya. Naye bw’oyimusa ekitangaala ekikakafu era ekitangaavu, n’okimulisa mu bugazi ku mmeeme ye, era bw’atagonda, okoleeza mu kifuba kye ebibonyoobonyo bya ggeyeena.

6. Kyonna ekiggya ku mwonoonyi okuwulira nti avunaanibwa, kiteekeddwateekeddwa okumuwa okubudaabudibwa okw’obulimba.

Omuntu gy’akoma okuwulira nti avunaanibwa, gye bukoma obuziba bw’obuyinike bwe. Naye ekintu kyonna ekikendeeza ku kuwulira kwe nti avunaanibwa, kya lwatu kikendeeza ku buyinike bwe, naye kuba kubudaabudibwa okujjudde okufa. Ekintu kyonna bwe kinaamuyamba okugabanya omusango, n’assa ekitundu kyagwo ku Katonda, kijja kumuwa okubudaabudibwa, naye buba buweerero obujja okuzikiriza emmeeme ye.

7. Okumubuulira ku butasobola bwe, kuba kubudaabuda okw’obulimba. Gamba omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu nti “Oyinza kukola ki? oli kitonde kya nnaku, ekinafu, tosobola kukola kintu.” Ojja kumuleetera okuwulira ekika ky’okuggwaamu amaanyi. Naye si bulumi obwo obw’amaanyi obw’okwejjusa, Katonda bw’anyigiriza emmeeme, bw’aba afuba okumutema n’okumuleeta mu kwenenya.

Bw’omugamba nti tasobola kugondera Njiri, mu butonde akikwata ng’obuweerero. Agamba mu mutima gwe nti, “Weewaawo, sisobola, ndi kitonde kya nnaku, ekinafu, sisobola kukola kino, era mazima Katonda tayinza kunsindika mu ggeyeena olw’obutakola kye sisobola kukola.” Lwaki, singa nnali nzikiriza nti omwonoonyi tasobola, nnandimugambye mu lwatu nti, “Totya, tovunaanibwa olw’obutagondera kuyita kw’Enjiri: kubanga tosobola, era Katonda talikusindika mu ggeyeena olw’obutakola ky’otolina maanyi kukola. “Omulamuzi ow’ensi yonna teyandisaanye akole kituufu?” Mmanyi nti si kya bulijjo abo aboogera ku butasobola bw’omwonoonyi, okukwatagana bwe batyo, n’okutuukiriza endowooza yaabwe. Naye omwonoonyi akisalawo kyonna kino, bw’atyo n’awulira ng’awummudde. Kyonna kya bulimba, era okubudaabudibwa kwonna okukivaamu, kuba kweterekera busungu ku lunaku lw’obusungu.

8. Kyonna ekireetera ebirowoozo by’omwonoonyi okulowooza nti alina okuba atakola kintu mu ddiini, kiteekeddwateekeddwa okumuwa okubudaabudibwa okw’obulimba.

Muwe endowooza nti talina kya kukola okuggyako okulinda ekiseera kya Katonda; mugambe nti okukyuka mulimu gwa Katonda, era asaanidde okugulekera ye; era nti alina okwegendereza, aleme kugezaako kuggya mulimu mu mukono gwa Katonda; era ajja kusalawo, nga bwe kyali emabega, nti tavunaanibwa, era ajja kuwulira ng’awummudde. Bw’aba alina kyokka okusirika, n’aleka Katonda akole omulimu, ng’omuntu bw’asirika okumusalako omukono, awulira ng’awummudde. Naye okuyigiriza ng’okwo, kwonna kukyamu. Omwonoonyi bw’aba alina okusirika bw’atyo n’aleka Katonda akikole, amangu ddala asalawo nti tavunaanibwa olw’obutakikola ye kennyini. Era okusalawo okwo si kwa butonde kwokka wabula kwa mateeka, kubanga tavunaanibwa,

Kya mazima nti waliwo amakulu okukyuka mwe kuli omulimu gwa Katonda. Naye kya bulimba, nga bwe kutera okulagibwa. Era kya mazima nti waliwo amakulu, okukyuka mwe kuli ekikolwa ky’omwonoonyi yennyini. Kya kusesa, n’olwekyo, okugamba, nti omwonoonyi takola kintu mu kuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri, oba takola kintu mu kukyusibwa, kubanga okukyuka kikolwa kye ye. Ekintu ekirina okukolebwa kye kyo ekitayinza kumukolerwa. Kintu ky’alina okukola, oba tekirikolebwa.

9. Okugamba omwonoonyi alinde ekiseera kya Katonda.

Emyaka egiwerako egiyise, nnasisinkana omukazi mu Philadelphia, eyali omweraliikirivu ku mmeeme ye, era eyali amaze ebbanga eddene mu mbeera eyo. Nnayogera naye, ne ngezaako okumanya embeera ye. Yambuulira ebintu bingi, era oluvannyuma n’agamba nti amanyi nti asaanidde okuba omwetegefu okulindirira Katonda ebbanga lyonna nga ye bwe yamulindirira. Yagamba nti, Katonda yali amulindiridde emyaka mingi nnyo, nga tannaba kufaayo ku kuyita kwe, era kaakano yakkiriza nti gwe mulimu gwe okulinda ekiseera kya Katonda okulaga okusaasira n’okukyusa emmeeme ye. Era yagamba nti, kino kye kyali okuyigiriza kwe yafuna. Alina okugumiikiriza, n’alinda ekiseera kya Katonda, era mu bbanga yandimuwadde obuweerero. Ayi, nga busirusiru bwa kyewuunyo!

Wano omwonoonyi ali mu bujeemu. Katonda ajja n’okusonyiwa mu mukono gumu, n’ekitala mu mukono omulala, n’agamba omwonoonyi yeenenye afune okusonyiyibwa, oba agaane azikirire. Era kaakano wano ajja omubuulizi w’Enjiri, n’agamba omwonoonyi nti “alinde ekiseera kya Katonda.” Mu butuufu agamba, nti Katonda si mwetegefu ye okwenenya kaakano, era si mwetegefu kumusonyiwa kaakano, era bw’atyo, mu butuufu, assa omusango gw’obuteenenya bwe ku Katonda. Mu kifo ky’okulaga omusango gw’omwonoonyi, mu butagondera Katonda mangu ddala, alaga obutali bwesimbu bwa Katonda mu kuwaayo ekiweebwayo, nga, mu butuufu, yali si mwetegefu kuwa mukisa.

Emirundi mingi ndowoozezza nti abayigiriza ng’abo baali beetaaga okunenya kwa Eriya bwe yasisinkana bakabona ba Baali. “Muleekaane nnyo! Katonda ddala! Osanga ali mu birowoozo bingi, oba aliko ebimutawaanya, oba ali ku lugendo. Ayinza okuba nga yeebase, nga yeetaaga kumuzuukusa.” Omubuulizi eyeetantala okutegeeza nti Katonda si mwetegefu, era agamba omwonoonyi okulinda ekiseera kya Katonda, yandisobodde kumpi okumugamba, nti kaakano Katonda yeebase, oba agenze ku lugendo, era tasobola kumufaako mu kiseera kino. Mazima ababudaabuzi ab’ennaku! Kumpi kuvvoola Katonda okw’obukambwe. Bameka abagenze mu musango, nga bamyufu wonna n’omusaayi gw’emyoyo, gye baalimba ne bazikiriza, nga babagamba nti Katonda si mwetegefu kubalokola, era nti balina okulinda ekiseera kya Katonda. Tewali kubuusabuusa, enjigiriza ng’eyo eteekeddwateekeddwa nnyo okuwa obuweerero obw’akaseera eri omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu. Emukkiriza okugamba nti, “Ayi, weewaawo, Katonda si mwetegefu, nnina okulinda ekiseera kya Katonda bwe ntyo nsobola okubeera mu kibi, ne neesanyusa okumala akaseera akalala, okutuusa lw’anaaba mwetegefu okumfaako, era olwo ndifuna eddiini.”

10. Kuba kubudaabuda okw’obulimba okugamba omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu okukola ekintu kyonna olw’obuweerero, ky’asobola okukola, n’atawaayo mutima gwe eri Katonda.

Omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu emirundi mingi aba mwetegefu okukola ekintu ekirala kyonna, okuggyako ekintu kyennyini Katonda ky’amulagira okukola. Mwetegefu okugenda ku nkomerero z’ensi, oba okusasula ensimbi ze, oba okugumira okubonaabona, oba ekintu kyonna, okuggyako okugondera Katonda mu bujjuvu era amangu ddala. Kaakano, bw’onoozzaako naye ensonga, n’omubuulira ekintu ekirala ky’ayinza okukola, n’ate n’aseebuka ensonga eyo, ajja kubudaabudibwa nnyo. Ayagala okuyigiriza okwo. Agamba nti, “Ayi, weewaawo, nja kukikola, njagala omubuulizi oyo, si mukambwe ng’abalala, alabika ng’ategeera embeera yange ey’enjawulo, era amanyi engeri y’okusonyiwa obunafu.”

Emirundi mingi kinzijukiza empisa y’omulwadde omulwadde ennyo, naye ng’akyawa nnyo omusawo omu n’eddagala erimu; naye nga oyo ye musawo yekka ategeera okujjanjaba endwadde ye, era nga eryo lye ddagala lyokka eriyinza okugiwonya. Kaakano omulwadde mwetegefu okukola ekintu ekirala kyonna, n’okuyita omusawo omulala yenna; era mweraliikirivu era ali mu buyinike, era abuuza mikwano gye gyonna oba tebasobola kumubuulira ky’anaakola, era ajja kumira eddagala lyonna ery’obulimba n’eddagala ly’abasawo abatali ba mazima mu nsi, nga tannaba kugondera kkubo lyokka eriyinza okumuwa obuweerero. Oluvannyuma, bw’amala okugezaako buli kintu awatali mugaso gwonna, bw’ataafe mu kugezesa, aleka okuwakanya kwe okutaliimu magezi, n’ayita omusawo, n’amira eddagala erituufu, n’awona. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n’abonoonyi. Bajja kukola n’obunyiikivu ekintu kyonna, bw’onoobaggyako okunyigirizibwa kuno okutagumiikirizika okw’obuvunaanyizibwa obuliwo kaakano okugondera Katonda. Nja kwogera ku bintu bitono abonoonyi bye bagambibwa okukola.

(1.) Okugamba omwonoonyi nti alina okukozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo. Gamba omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu kino—Olina okukozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo, era awummula. “Ayi, weewaawo, nja kukikola, bwe kiba nti kye kyokka. Nnalowooza nti Katonda ansaba okwenenya n’okumugondera kaakano. Naye okukozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo bwe kunaamala, nja kukikola n’omutima gwange gwonna.” Yali mu buyinike emabega, kubanga yali azingiziddwa mu nsonda, era nga tamanyi ludda lwa kukyukira. Omutima gwe ogumulamula gwali gumuzingizza, ng’ekisenge eky’omuliro, era nga gumukubiriza okwenenya kaakano. Naye kino kimuwummuza amangu ddala, n’awulira obulungi, era yeebaza nnyo, bw’agamba, nti yafuna omuwabuzi omulungi bw’atyo mu buyinike bwe. Naye ayinza okukozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo, nga bw’aziyita, okutuusa ku lunaku olw’omusango, n’atalongooka n’akatono olw’ekyo, naye ajja kwanguya bwanguya ekkubo lye eri okufa. Okukozesa kw’omwonoonyi engeri ezaateekebwawo kye ki, okuggyako obujeemu eri Katonda? Katonda akozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo. Ekkanisa ekozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo okukyusa n’okulokola abonoonyi, okubanyigiriza, n’okubaleeta mu kugonda. Naye omwonoonyi alina kakwate ki n’okukozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo? Onoomuteeka okukozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo okuzza ku Katonda, bw’atyo n’akola okwenkanya mu nsonga eno? Oba alina okukozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo okwefuula agondera Katonda? Anaagenda atya okukola n’engeri ze ezaateekebwawo okwefuula agonda? Kuba kugamba bugambi omwonoonyi nti, “Tekikwetaagisa kugondera Katonda kaakano, naye kozesa bukozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo okumala akaseera, olabe oba tosobola kugonza mutima gwa Katonda gy’oli, alyoke aleke ensonga eno ey’okugonda okutaliiko kakwakkulizo.” Kuba kwekwasa bwekwasa okwewala omulimu ogw’okugondera Katonda amangu ddala. Kya mazima nti abonoonyi, nga bakubirizibwa okufaayo ku ssanyu lyabwe, emirundi mingi bafaayo ku nsonga y’eddiini, bagenda mu nkuŋŋaana, ne basaba, ne basoma, n’ebintu bingi ng’ebyo. Naye mu bino byonna, tebafaayo ku kitiibwa kya Katonda, era tebagenderera na kumugondera. Ekigendererwa kyabwe, si kugonda, kubanga singa kyali bwe kityo, tebandibadde boonoonyi abateenenyezza. N’olwekyo, tebakozesa ngeri ezaateekebwawo okuba Abakristaayo, wabula okufuna okusonyiyibwa, n’essuubi. Kya busirusiru okugamba nti omwonoonyi ateenenyezza akozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo okwenenya, kubanga kino kye kimu n’okugamba nti mwetegefu okwenenya, oba mu bigambo ebirala, nti yeenenya, era si mwonoonyi ateenenyezza. Bwe kityo, okugamba nti omwonoonyi atakyuse akozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo ng’agenderera okufuuka Omukristaayo, kiba kwekontanya, kubanga kiba kugamba, nti mwetegefu okuba Omukristaayo, kye kimu n’okugamba nti mukristaayo dda.

(2.) Okugamba omwonoonyi okusaba omutima omuggya. Lumu nnawulira omusomesa w’essomero lya Ssande omwatiikirivu ng’akola kino. Yali kumpi kitaawe w’amasomero ga Ssande mu nsi eno. Yayita omuwala omuto gy’ali, n’atandika okwogera naye. “Muwala wange omuto, oli Mukristaayo?” Nedda, ssebo. “Kale, tosobola kuba Mukristaayo, ggwe kennyini, osobola?” Nedda, ssebo. “Nedda, tosobola kuba Mukristaayo, tosobola kukyusa mutima gwo ggwe kennyini, naye olina okusaba omutima omuggya, ekyo kyokka ky’osobola okukola, saba Katonda, Katonda ajja kukuwa omutima omuggya.” Yali musajja mukadde era ow’ekitiibwa, naye nnawulira kumpi nga njagala okumunenya mu lwatu mu linnya lya Mukama, Saasobola kugumira kumuwulira ng’alimba omwana oyo, ng’amugamba nti tasobola kuba Mukristaayo. Katonda agamba nti “Musabe omutima omuggya?” N’akatono. Agamba nti, “Mwekolere omutima omuggya.” Era omwonoonyi tasaanye kugambibwa kusaba Katonda amukolere omulimu gwe, wabula agende agukole ye kennyini. Mmanyi nti Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli, omuntu omulungi, yasaba. “Ontondemu omutima omulongoofu, Ayi Katonda, era onteekemu omwoyo omulungi munda yange.” Yalina okukkiriza era yasaba mu kukkiriza. Naye ekyo kintu kya njawulo nnyo ku kuteeka omujeemu omukakanyavu okusaba omutima omuggya. Tewali kubuusabuusa, omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu ajja kusanyukira nnyo okuyigiriza ng’okwo. “Lwaki, nnamanya nti nneetaaga omutima omuggya, era nti nsaanidde okwenenya, naye nnalowooza nti nnina okukikola nze kennyini, ndi mwetegefu nnyo okusaba Katonda akikole, nnakyawa okukikola nze kennyini, naye sirina kye nkiwakanyaako Katonda okukikola, bw’anaayagala, era nja kukisabira, bwe kiba nti ekyo kyokka kye kyetaagibwa.”

(3.) Okugamba omwonoonyi okugumiikiriza. Era ka tugambe agumiikiriza. Kikakafu nti ajja kuzikirizibwa nga bwe kyandibadde singa abadde mu ggeyeena okuva ensi lwe yatondebwa. Okweraliikirira kwe kuva mu kuziyiza kwe kwokka, era singa yandigonze, kwandikomye. Era kaakano, onoomugamba okugumiikiriza mu kintu kyennyini ekireeta obuyinike bwe? Ka tugambe omwana wange, mu busungu, akasuka ekitabo oba ekintu ku ttaka. Mmugamba nti “Kironde,” era mu kifo ky’okufaayo ku kye ŋŋamba, adduka n’agenda azannya. “Kironde!” Alaba nti siriimu muzannyo, n’atandika okulabika ng’omukkakkamu. “Kironde, oba nja kuleeta omuggo.” Ne nyimusa omukono gwange okuleeta omuggo. Ayimirira busirise. “Kironde, oba olina okukubibwa.” Ajja mpolampola mu kifo, n’atandika okukaaba. “Kironde, mwana wange, oba mazima ojja kubonerezebwa.” Kaakano ali mu buyinike, era akaaba n’asinda ng’olinga ekifuba kye kigenda kwabika, naye ate n’asigala nga mukakanyavu ng’olinga amanyi nti siyinza kumubonereza. Kaakano ntandika okumunyigiriza n’ensonga ez’okugonda n’okuwulira, naye ayimiridde awo, mu bulumi, era oluvannyuma n’abwatuka nti, “Ayi, taata, mpulira bubi nnyo, ndowooza ngenda ndongooka.” Era kaakano, ka tugambe muliraanwa ayingira, n’alaba omwana ng’ayimiridde awo, mu bulumi buno bwonna obw’obukakanyavu. Muliraanwa amubuuza lwaki ayimiridde awo, era ky’akola. “Ayi, nkozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo okulonda ekitabo ekyo.” Singa muliraanwa ono yandigambye omwana nti, “Gumiikiriza, gumiikiriza, mulenzi wange, ojja kukirondawo mu bbanga,” nandikoze ki? Lwaki, nandimugobye mu nnyumba. Ategeeza ki okuzzaamu omwana wange amaanyi mu bujeemu bwe?

Kaakano, Katonda ayita omwonoonyi okwenenya, amutiisatiisa, asowola ekitala ekimasamasa, amusendasenda, akozesa ensonga, era omwonoonyi ali mu buyinike okutuuka ku bulumi, kubanga yeeraba ng’asindikiddwa ku kulonda okw’entiisa okw’okuleka ebibi bye oba okugenda mu ggeyeena. Asaanidde amangu ddala okussa wansi ebyokulwanyisa bye, n’amenya omutima gwe omulundi gumu. Naye aziyiza, n’alwanagana n’okusalirwa omusango mu mutima, era ekyo kye kireeta obuyinike bwe. Kaakano onoomugamba okugumiikiriza? Okugumiikiriza mu ki? Mu kulwanagana ne Katonda! Ekyo kye kiragiro kyennyini Setaani kye yandiwadde. Setaani ky’ayagala kyonna kwe kumulaba ng’agumiikiriza mu kkubo lyennyini ly’agendamu, era okuzikirira kwe kukakafu. Setaani ayinza okugenda okwebaka.

(4.) Okugamba omwonoonyi okunyiikira okugenda mu maaso. Kwe kugamba, “Oli mu kkubo ddungi, nyiikira bunyiikizi okugenda mu maaso, era ojja kutuuka mu ggulu.” Kino kiri ku ndowooza nti amaaso ge gatunudde eri eggulu, ng’ate mu butuufu amaaso ge gatunudde eri ggeyeena, era anyiikira okugenda mu maaso, era tewali lwe yali ayanguye nga kaakano, ng’aziyiza Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Emirundi mingi mpulidde ekiragiro kino nga kiweebwa, ng’omwonoonyi ali mu kkubo ebbi ennyo nga bwe kisoboka. Ky’osaanidde okumugamba kiri nti, “YIMIRIRA—mwonoonyi, yimirira, totwala ddaala ddala mu kkubo eryo, lituusa mu ggeyeena.” Katonda amugamba ayimirire, era olw’okuba tayagala kuyimirira, ali mu buyinike. Kaakano, lwaki ogezaako okumubudaabuda mu ngeri eno?

(5.) Gamba omwonoonyi nti alina okugezaako okwenenya n’okuwaayo omutima gwe eri Katonda. “Ayi, weewaawo,” omwonoonyi bw’agamba, “ndi mwetegefu okugezaako. Emirundi mingi ngezezzaako okukikola, era nja kuddamu okugezaako.” Ah, Katonda akugamba okugezaako okwenenya? Ensi yonna yandibadde nneetegefu okugezaako okwenenya, mu ngeri yaayo. Okuwa ekiragiro kino kitegeeza nti kizibu nnyo okwenenya, era oboolyawo tekisoboka, era nti ekisinga obulungi omwonoonyi ky’ayinza okukola kwe kugezaako n’alaba oba asobola okukikola oba nedda. Kino kiki okuggyako okuteeka ekiragiro kyo mu kifo ky’ekya Katonda. Katonda tasaba kitono ku kwenenya n’omutima omutukuvu. Ekintu kyonna ekitono ku ekyo kuba kumubudaabuda n’ebitaliimu, “tewali kisigaddeyo ku bye mwanzizeemu wabula obulimba.”

(6.) Okumugamba okusaba okwenenya. “Ayi weewaawo, nja kusaba okwenenya, bwe kiba nti ekyo kyokka. Nnali mu buyinike kubanga nnalowooza nti Katonda ansaba okwenenya, naye bw’anaakikola, nsobola okulinda.” Bw’atyo n’awulira ng’awummudde, era ali mu mirembe ddala.

(7.) Okugamba omwonoonyi okusaba okusalirwa omusango mu mutima, oba okusaba Mwoyo Mutukuvu amulage ebibi bye, oba okufuba okufuna ekitangaala ekisingawo ku nsonga y’omusango gwe, okwongera ku kusalirwa omusango kwe mu mutima.

Bino byonna bye kyennyini omwonoonyi by’ayagala, kubanga bimuggyako okunyigirizibwa kw’obuvunaanyizibwa obuliwo kaakano. Ayagala bwagazi budde butono obusingawo. Ekintu kyonna ekinaalwisaayo okunyigirizibwa okuliwo kaakano okw’obuvunaanyizibwa okwenenya amangu ddala buba buweerero. Ayagalira ki okusalirwa omusango mu mutima okusingawo? Katonda awa ekiragiro ekyo kyonna eri omwonoonyi ateenenyezza? Katonda akitwala nti alina dda okusalirwa omusango mu mutima okumala. Era bw’atyo bw’ali. Ogamba nti tasobola kutegeera bibi bye byonna? Bw’asobola okutegeera kimu kyokka ku byo, yeenenye ekyo ekimu, era Mukristaayo. Ka tugambe yandisobodde okubiraba byonna, nsonga ki eriwo okulowooza nti yandibyenenyezza byonna, okusinga nga bwe yandyenenyezza ekyo ekimu ky’alaba? Bino byonna kuba kubudaabuda mwonoonyi nga tumuteeka okukola ekyo ky’asobola okukola, n’atawaayo mutima gwe eri Katonda.

11. Engeri endala okubudaabuda okw’obulimba mwe kuweerwa abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu, kwe kubagamba nti Katonda agezesa okukkiriza kwabwe ng’abakuumira mu kyoto, era nti balina okulindirira Mukama n’obugumiikiriza. Ng’olinga Katonda y’alina ensobi, oba ng’ayimiridde mu kkubo ng’amulemesa okuba Omukristaayo. Oba ng’olinga omwonoonyi ateenenyezza alina okukkiriza! Nga muzizo! Ka tugambe omuntu omu agamba omwana wange, ng’ayimiridde ku mabbali g’ekitabo nga bwe nnyinnyonnyodde, nti “Linda n’obugumiikiriza, mulenzi, kitaawo agezesa okukkiriza kwo.” Nedda. Omwonoonyi y’agezesa obugumiikiriza n’okulwawo kwa Katonda. Katonda teyeetegese kubonyaabonya mwonoonyi, n’okumuyigiriza essomo ly’obugumiikiriza. Naye amulindirira, era afuba okumuleeta amangu ddala mu mbeera y’ebirowoozo ng’eyo enaakifuula ekikwatagana okujjuza emmeeme ye emirembe egy’omu ggulu. Era omwonoonyi anaazzibwamu amaanyi okuziyiza olw’endowooza nti Katonda azannya naye? MWEGENDEREZE. Katonda yagamba nti Omwoyo we taawakanenga na muntu emirembe gyonna.

12. Okubudaabuda okulala okw’obulimba kwe kugamba omwonoonyi nti, Kola omulimu gwo, okukyuka kwo okulekere Katonda.

Lumu nnawulira omukadde w’ekkanisa ng’agamba omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu nti, “Kola omulimu gwo, okukyuka kwo okulekere Katonda, ajja kukikola mu kiseera kye ne mu ngeri ye.” Ekyo kyali kye kimu n’okumugamba nti tegwali mulimu gwe okukyuka kaakano. Teyagamba nti, Kola omulimu gwo, obulokozi bwo obulekere Katonda. Ekyo kyandibadde kituufu ekimala, kubanga kyandibadde kumugamba bugambi okugondera Katonda, era kyandizingiddemu okukyuka ng’omulimu ogusooka ogw’emirimu gyonna. Naye yamugamba okulekera Katonda okukyuka kwe. Era omukadde ono, eyawa okuwabula ng’okwo, yali musajja eyasoma nnyo. Nga kya busirusiru! Ng’olinga yandisobodde okukola omulimu gwe n’atakyuka. Ng’olinga Katonda yali agenda kukyusa mwonoonyi n’aleka omwonoonyi okutuula mu kkakkamu wansi waakyo ng’akozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo. Kya ntiisa! Nedda. Katonda amulagidde okwekolera omutima omuggya, era mmwe mwegendereze nga bwe mumubudaabuda n’okuddamu okw’obulimba.

13. Oluusi abeeyita ba ddiini bajja kugezaako okubudaabuda omwonoonyi, nga bamugamba nti, “Toggwaamu maanyi; nnamala ebbanga ddene mu kkubo lino nga sinnafuna kubudaabudibwa.” Bajja kumugamba nti, “Nnali nsaliddwa omusango mu mutima okumala wiiki zino n’ezo—oba oboolyawo emyezi gino n’egyo, oba oluusi emyaka, era mpise mu bino byonna, era mmanyi ddala bw’owulira, obumanyirivu bwo bwe bumu n’obwange, ddala, era oluvannyuma lw’ebbanga eddene bwe lityo nnafuna obuweerero, era sibuusabuusa nti ojja kubufuna mu bbanga. Toggwaamu ssuubi, Katonda ajja kukubudaabuda mangu.” Okugamba omwonoonyi okuguma mu bujeemu bwe! Ayi, kya ntiisa. Abeeyita ba ddiini ng’abo basaanidde okukwatibwa ensonyi. Ka tugambe wali osaliddwa omusango mu mutima okumala wiiki nnyingi bwe zityo, oluvannyuma n’ofuna obuweerero, kye kintu ekisembayo ky’osaanidde okubuulira omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu. Kino kiki okuggyako okumuzzaamu amaanyi okunyweza, ng’ate omulimu gwe gwe kugonda. Wanyweza okumala wiiki nnyingi bwe zityo nga Omwoyo awakana naawe? Wasaanira kyokka okuzikirizibwa okusingawo, olw’obukakanyavu bwo n’obusiru bwo.

Mwonoonyi! si kabonero nti Katonda ajja kukuleka ggwe okumala ebbanga eddene bwe lityo, oba nti Omwoyo we ajja kusigala naawe okuziyizibwa. Era jjukira, Omwoyo bw’aggyibwawo, ojja kusindikibwa mu ggeyeena.

14. “Nnina okukkiriza okukkiriza nti ojja kukyusibwa.”

Olina okukkiriza okukkiriza! Okukkiriza kwo kwesigamye ku ki? Ku kisuubizo kya Katonda? Ku maanyi ga Mwoyo Mutukuvu? Olwo oziyiza okukkiriza kwo wekka. Ekigendererwa kyennyini eky’Omwoyo wa Katonda, kwe, kuggya ku mwonoonyi akabonero ke akasembayo ak’essuubi, ng’akyali mu kibi; okusaanyaawo buli lwazi n’akati k’ayinza okwekwatako. Era ekigendererwa ky’okuyigiriza kwo kisaanidde okuba kye kimu. Osaanidde okukwatagana n’enteekateeka ya Katonda. Mu ngeri eno yokka mw’oyinza okukola ekirungi kyonna, ng’omunyigiriza ddala eri omulimu, okugonda amangu ddala n’aleka emmeeme ye mu mikono gya Katonda. Naye omuntu gw’alowooza nti Mukristaayo bw’amugamba nti, “Nnina okukkiriza okukkiriza nti ojja kukyusibwa,” kimuwanirira mu kusuubira kwe okw’obulimba. Mu kifo ky’okumuggya ku ssuubi lye ery’obulimba, n’okumusuula ku Kristo, omukyusa bukyusi yeewanike ku kukkiriza kwo, era afune okubudaabudibwa kubanga olina okukkiriza ku lulwe. Kino kyonna kubudaabuda kwa bulimba, okuleeta okufa.

15. “Nja kukusabira.” Oluusi abeeyita ba ddiini bagezaako okubudaabuda omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu mu ngeri eno, nga bamugamba nti, “Nja kukusabira.” Kuno kubudaabuda kwa bulimba, kubanga kuleetera omwonoonyi okwesiga okusaba okwo, mu kifo ky’okwesiga Kristo. Omwonoonyi agamba nti, “Musajja mulungi, era Katonda awulira okusaba kw’abantu abalungi, tewali kubuusabuusa okusaba kwe kulituuka ne kuwangula, era ndikyusibwa, sirowooza nti ndibula.” Era okweraliikirira kwe, obulumi bwe, byonna biggwaawo. Omukazi omu yagamba omubuulizi nti, “Sirina ssuubi kaakano, naye nnina okukkiriza mu kusaba kwo.” Okukkiriza kwennyini, kuno, Setaani kw’ayagala babeere nakwo—okukkiriza mu kusaba mu kifo ky’okukkiriza mu Kristo.

16. “Nsanyuka okukulaba mu kkubo lino, era nsuubira nti ojja kuba mwesigwa, onyweze.” Kino kiki okuggyako okusanyuka okumulaba mu bujeemu eri Katonda? Kubanga ekyo kye kifo kyennyini ky’ayimiriddemu. Aziyiza okusalirwa omusango mu mutima, era aziyiza omutima gwe ogumulamula, era aziyiza Mwoyo Mutukuvu, naye ate osanyuka okumulaba mu kkubo lino, era osuubira nti ajja kuba mwesigwa anyweze. Waliwo amakulu, mazima, mwe kiyinza okwogerwa nti embeera ye erimu essuubi okusinga bwe yali mu busiru. Kubanga Katonda amukakasizza, era ayinza okuwangula mu kumukyusa n’okumuwangula. Naye ago si ge makulu omwonoonyi yennyini mw’anaakitegeera. Ajja kulowooza nti omutwala ng’ali mu kkubo eririmu essuubi, kubanga akola bulungi okusinga edda. Ng’ate omusango gwe n’akabi ke, mu butuufu, binene okusinga bwe byali bibadde emabega. Era mu kifo ky’okusanyuka, osaanidde okuba mu buyinike ne mu bulumi, okumulaba ng’aziyiza bw’atyo Mwoyo Mutukuvu, kubanga buli kaseera k’akola kino, ali mu kabi ak’okulekebwa Katonda, n’aweebwayo eri obukakanyavu bw’omutima n’okuggwaamu essuubi.

17. “Olifuna empeera yo olw’ekyo, mu bbanga, Katonda alikusasula.” Weewaawo, mmwe aboonoonyi, Katonda alibasasula, bwe mweyongera mu kkubo lino, alibateeka mu muliro gwa ggeyeena. Empeera olw’obuyinike buno bwonna! Weewaawo, bwe muliweebwa empeera olw’akyo, eriba mu ggeyeena. Lumu nnawulira omwonoonyi ng’agamba nti, “Mpulira bubi nnyo, nnina essuubi ery’amaanyi nti ndifuna empeera yange.” Naye omuntu oyo oluvannyuma yagamba nti, “Tewali wonna wayinza kusangibwa mwonoonyi muddugavu nga nze, era tewali kibi mu bulamu bwange kirabika kiddugavu bwe kityo, era ekizikiriza, ng’ekigambo ekyo.” Yajjula okwejjusa, nti yali yalina endowooza ng’eyo, okulowooza nti Katonda yandimuwadde empeera olw’okubonaabona n’obuyinike bungi bwe butyo, ng’ate yabwereetera yekka, awatali nsonga, olw’okuziyiza kwe okubi eri amazima, Amazima gali nti, abantu ng’abo kye baagala, kwe kubudaabuda omwonoonyi, era nga bonna bali mu kizikiza bo bennyini ku nsonga y’eddiini, kya lwatu bamuwa okubudaabudibwa okw’obulimba.

18. Okubudaabuda okulala okw’obulimba, kwe kugamba omwonoonyi nti teyeenenyezza kimala. Amazima gali nti, teyeenenyezza n’akatono. Katonda bulijjo abudaabuda omwonoonyi amangu ddala nga yeenenyezza. Ekiragiro kino kitegeeza nti enneewulira ze ntuufu okutuuka gye zituuka. Okutegeeza nti alina okwenenya kwonna, kwe kumulimba, n’okumukumpanya okuggyako emmeeme ye.

19. Abantu oluusi babudaabuda omwonoonyi nga bamugamba nti “Bw’oba nga walondebwa, olireetebwa munda.” Lumu nnawulira ku mbeera omuntu eyali mu buyinike bungi obw’ebirowoozo mwe yasindikibwa okwogera n’omubuulizi ow’omu kitundu ekiriraanyeewo, Baayogera okumala ebbanga ddene. Omuntu bwe yali agenda, omubuulizi n’amugamba nti, “Nandyagadde okuwandiika olunyiriri ng’ayita mu ggwe, eri kitaawo.” Kitaawe yali musajja atya Katonda. Omubuulizi n’awandiika ebbaluwa, ne yeerabira okugisiba. Omwonoonyi bwe yali agenda ewaka, n’alaba nti ebbaluwa teyasibibwa, n’alowooza mu mutima gwe, nti oboolyawo omubuulizi yali amuwandiiseeko, era okwagala kwe okumanya oluvannyuma ne kumuleetera okugibikkula n’agisoma. Era eyo n’asanga ewandiikiddwa mu makulu gano: “Ssebo omwagalwa. Nsanze mutabani wo ng’asaliddwa omusango mu mutima, era ng’ali mu buyinike bungi, era kirabika nga si kyangu okwogera ekintu kyonna okumuwa obuweerero. Naye, bw’aba nga omu ku balonde, mazima aliyingizibwa.” Yayagala okwogera ekintu okubudaabuda kitaawe. Naye kaakano, mwetegereze. Ebbaluwa eyo yabulako katono okuzikiriza emmeeme ye. Yatuula ku njigiriza y’okulondebwa—“Bwe mba nga nalondebwa, ndireetebwa munda,” era okusalirwa omusango mu mutima kwe ne kuggwaawo kwonna. Emyaka oluvannyuma yazuukusibwa n’akyuka, naye oluvannyuma lw’okulwana okunene kwokka, era nga tekinnabaawo okutuusa endowooza eyo ey’obulimba lwe yasangulibwa mu birowoozo bye, n’aleetebwa okulaba nti talina kakwate n’akatono n’enjigiriza y’okulondebwa, naye bw’ataayenenye, yandizikiriziddwa.

20. Kitera nnyo abantu abamu okugamba omwonoonyi azuukusiddwa nti, “Oli mu kkubo ddungi nnyo, nsanyuka okukulaba bw’otyo, era mpulira nga nzizibwamu amaanyi ku ggwe.” Oluusi kirabika ng’olinga ekkanisa eri mu mukago ne Setaani okuyamba abonoonyi okuziyiza Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Ekintu Mwoyo Mutukuvu ky’ayagala okuleetera omwonoonyi okuwulira, kwe, nti amakubo ge gonna makyamu, era nti gatuusa mu ggeyeena. Era buli muntu akola enkwe okuleeta endowooza ekikontana. Omwoyo agezaako okumumalamu amaanyi, nabo bagezaako okumuzzaamu amaanyi; Omwoyo okumuleetera obuyinike, ng’amulaga nti mukyamu wonna, nabo okumubudaabuda nga bagamba nti akola bulungi. Kituuse wano, nti okuziyiza amazima okusinga obubi, n’ekiziyiza ekisinga obunene eri Omwoyo kirisibuka mu kkanisa? Mwonoonyi! Tokkiriza kintu kyonna ng’ekyo. Toli mu kkubo lirimu ssuubi. Tokola bulungi, wabula bubi; obubi bwonna nga bw’osobola, ng’oziyiza Mwoyo Mutukuvu.

21. Engeri endala etta ennyo, okubudaabuda okw’obulimba mwe kuweerwa abonoonyi, kwe kubateekako ebisuubizo ebimu eby’Ebyawandiikibwa, ebyategekerwa abatukuvu bokka. Kino kikodyo kikulu kya Setaani. Kikolebwa nnyo abakkiriza nti bonna balirokolebwa. Naye Abakristaayo emirundi mingi bakikola. Ng’ekyokulabirako:

(1.) “Balina omukisa abali mu nnaku, kubanga abo balisanyusibwa.” Emirundi emeka ekyawandiikibwa kino gye kissiddwa ku bonoonyi abeeraliikirivu, abaali mu buyinike kubanga tebaagala kugondera Katonda; balina omukisa mmwe abali mu nnaku. Mazima! Ekyo kya mazima, bwe baba mu nnaku olw’ennaku ey’okutya Katonda. Naye omwonoonyi ono ali mu nnaku olw’ensonga ki? Ali mu nnaku kubanga etteeka lya Katonda ttukuvu n’ebisaanyizo bye eby’obulokozi binywevu bwe bityo nti tasobola kubikkakkanya kutuuka ku birowoozo bye. Gamba omujeemu ng’oyo—Balina omukisa abali mu nnaku! Wandisobodde okukissa ku abo abali mu ggeyeena. Eyo nayo waliyo ennaku. Omwonoonyi ali mu nnaku kubanga tewali kkubo ddala lya bulokozi, kubanga Katonda mutukuvu nnyo bw’atyo nti amulagira okuleka ebibi bye byonna, era awulira, nti ekiseera kituuse, nti alina oba okubireka, oba okuzikirizibwa. Tunaamugamba, nti alisanyusibwa? Genda ogambe Setaani nti, “Setaani ow’ennaku, oli mu nnaku kaakano, naye Bayibuli egamba nti olina omukisa bw’oba mu nnaku, era olisanyusibwa mu bbanga.”

(2.) “Oyo anoonya, azuula.” Kino kigambibwa abonoonyi mu ngeri etegeeza nti omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu anoonya eddiini. Ekisuubizo kino kyakolebwa nga kyogera ku Bakristaayo, abasaba mu kukkiriza, era abanoonya okukola by’ayagala Katonda, era tekikwatagana n’abo abanoonya essuubi oba okubudaabudibwa; wabula okunoonya okutukuvu. Okukissa ku mwonoonyi ateenenyezza, kwe kumulimba kwokka, kubanga okunoonya kwe si kwa ngeri eno. Okumugamba nti “Onoonya, si bwe kiri? Kale, noonya, era olizuula,” kwe kukuza okwerimba okutta. Ng’akyali ateenenyezza, talina kwegomba kwonna, Setaani kw’atayinza kubeera nakwo, n’asigala nga Setaani.

Singa yalina okwegomba okukola omulimu gwe, singa yali anoonya okukola by’ayagala Katonda, n’okuleka ebibi bye, yandibadde Mukristaayo. Naye okubudaabuda omwonoonyi ateenenyezza, n’ekisuubizo ng’ekyo, wandisobodde okubudaabuda Setaani.

(3.) “Tulemenga okuterebuka mu kukola obulungi, kubanga oluvannyuma tulikungula emikisa, bwe tutaggwaamu maanyi.” Okukissa ku mwonoonyi olw’okubudaabudibwa, kya busirusiru. Ng’olinga waliwo ky’akola okusanyusa Katonda. Tali akoze bulungi, era tali akoze bubi okusinga kaakano. Ka tugambe muliraanwa wange, eyayingira nga ngezaako okuwangula omwana wange, yandigambye omwana nti, “Oluvannyuma olikungula, bw’otaggwaamu maanyi,” nnandigambye ki? “Okukungula, weewaawo, olikungula, bw’otoleka bukakanyavu bwo, olikungula mazima, kubanga nja kukozesa omuggo.” Bwe kityo omwonoonyi alwanagana alikungula okuzikirira kwa ggeyeena, bw’ataaleke bibi bye.

22. Abeeyita ba ddiini abamu, bwe bagezaako okwogera n’abonoonyi abazuukusiddwa, baagala nnyo okugamba nti, “Nja kukubuulira bye nnayitamu.” Kino kyambika kya kabi, era emirundi mingi kiwa Setaani ekyokukwata okumutwala mu ggeyeena, ng’agezaako okukoppa bye wayitamu. Bw’obimubuulira, n’alowooza nti bye bya Mukristaayo, kumpi awatali kubuusabuusa ajja kugezaako okubikoppa, era mu kifo ky’okugoberera Enjiri, oba obulagirizi bw’Omwoyo mu mmeeme ye, agoberera ekyokulabirako kyo. Kino kya busirusiru era kya kabi. Talibeera na nneewulira ddala nga ze walina. Tewali bantu babiri abaali bakoleddwako mu ngeri y’emu ddala. Bye bayitamu abantu tebifaanagana nga bwe batafaanagana mu maaso. Ekkubo ng’eryo kiyinzika nnyo okumukyamya. Ekigendererwa, emirundi mingi, si kirala wabula okumuzzaamu amaanyi, mu kifo kyennyini w’atasaanye kuzzibwamu maanyi, nga tannaba kugondera Katonda, Era kiteekeddwateekeddwa okulemesa omulimu gwa Katonda mu mmeeme ye.

23. Emirundi emeka abantu gye bajja okugamba omwonoonyi azuukusiddwa nti Katonda atandise omulimu omulungi mu ye, era aligutuukiriza. Mmanyi abazadde aboogera bwe batyo n’abaana baabwe, era amangu ddala nga balabye abaana baabwe nga bazuukusiddwa, ne baleka okweraliikirira kwonna okwasooka ku bo, ne batuula mu mirembe, nga balowooza nti kaakano Katonda yali atandise omulimu omulungi mu baana baabwe, yandigutuukirizza. Kyandibadde kya magezi bwe kityo omulimi okwogera bw’atyo ku mmere ye ey’empeke, era amangu ddala ng’emeze okuva mu ttaka, n’agamba nti, “Kale, Katonda atandise omulimu omulungi mu nnimiro yange, era aligutuukiriza.” Kiki ekyandirowoozeddwa ku mulimi eyandirekeddeyo okuzimba olukomera lwe, kubanga Katonda yali atandise omulimu gw’okumuwa amakungula g’empeke? Bw’ogamba omwonoonyi bw’otyo, n’akukkiriza, mazima kijja kuba kuzikirira kwe, kubanga kijja kumulemesa okukola ekyo ekyetaagisa ddala okulokolebwa kwe. Bwe kiba nti, amangu ddala ng’omwonoonyi azuukusiddwa, ayigirizibwa nti kaakano Katonda atandise omulimu omulungi, ogwetaaga obwetaavu okutuukirizibwa, era nti Katonda mazima aligutuukiriza, alaba nti talina nsonga ndala ya kweraliikirira, kubanga, mu butuufu, talina kirala kya kukola. Bw’atyo ajja kuggibwako okunyigirizibwa okwo okutagumiikirizika okw’obuvunaanyizibwa obuliwo kaakano, okwenenya n’okugondera Katonda. Era bw’aggibwako okuwulira obuvunaanyizibwa bwe okukikola, talikikola.

24. Abamu bajja kugamba omwonoonyi nti, “Kale, olese ebibi byo, si bwe kiri?” “Ayi, weewaawo,” omwonoonyi bw’agamba. Ng’ate kyonna kya bulimba, tali alese bibi bye kaseera na kamu, akyusizza bukyusa engeri emu ey’ekibi okudda mu ndala; yeeteeka bwessi mu mbeera empya ey’okuziyiza. Era okumugamba, nti abirese, kwe kumuwa okubudaabudibwa okw’obulimba.

25. Oluusi ekiragiro kino kiweebwa olw’ekigendererwa eky’okuggyawo obulumi bw’omwonoonyi omweraliikirivu, “Kola ky’osobola, era Katonda ajja kukola ebisigadde,” oba “Kola ky’osobola, era Katonda ajja kukuyamba.” Kino kye kimu n’okugamba omwonoonyi nti, “Tosobola kukola Katonda ky’akulagira okukola, naye bw’onookola ky’osobola, Katonda ajja kukuyamba, ku bisigadde.” Kaakano abonoonyi emirundi mingi bafuna endowooza nti bakoze byonna bye basobola, ng’ate, mu butuufu, tebakoze kintu n’akatono, baziyizza buziyiza Katonda n’amaanyi gaabwe gonna. Emirundi mingi mbawulidde nga bagamba nti, “Nkoze byonna bye nsobola, era sifuna buweerero, nnyinza kukola ki okusingawo?” Kaakano, mulaba nga bwe kiyinza okubudaabuda omuntu ng’oyo omu ku beeyita ba ddiini okuyingira n’agamba nti, “Bw’onookola ky’osobola, Katonda ajja kukuyamba.” Kiggyawo obuyinike bwe bwonna obw’amaanyi omulundi gumu. Ayinza okuba nga tali mu mirembe, era nga si musanyufu, naye obulumi bwe buweddewo.

26. Nate bagamba nti, “Osaanidde okwebaza olw’ebyo by’olina, era osuubire ebisingawo.” Omwonoonyi bw’aba asaliddwa omusango mu mutima, bamugamba nti asaanidde okwebaza olw’okusalirwa omusango mu mutima, n’okusuubira okukyuka. Bw’aba alina enneewulira yonna, asaanidde okwebaza olw’enneewulira gy’alina, ng’olinga enneewulira ye yali nneewulira ya ddiini, nga talina ddiini okusinga Setaani. Alina ensonga ey’okwebaza, mazima; okwebaza nti tali mu ggeyeena, n’okwebaza nti Katonda akyamulindirira. Naye kya kusesa okumugamba nti asaanidde okwebaza ku bikwata ku mbeera y’ebirowoozo bye, ng’ate mu kiseera kyonna aziyiza Omutonzi we n’amaanyi ge gonna.

ENSOBI MU KUSABIRA ABONOONYI.

Wano nja kwogera ku nsobi ntono mu kusabira abonoonyi nga weebali, endowooza embi mwe zireetebwa ku birowoozo byabwe, era olw’ekyo, emirundi mingi bafuna okubudaabudibwa okw’obulimba mu buyinike bwabwe.

1. Abantu oluusi basabira abonoonyi, ng’olinga basaanira OKUSAASIRWA okusinga OKUNENYEZEBWA. Babasabira ng’ABALI MU NNAKU. “Mukama yamba abali mu nnaku bano abafumiitiriza,” ng’olinga bali mu nnaku bunnaku, ng’omuntu afiiriddwa mukwano gwe, oba eyasanze ekibonyoobonyo ekirala, era nga tebasobola kukyewala, era nga banakuwalidde nnyo, naye okufa kwali kwa kujja, era bwe batyo baali basaanira nnyo okusaasirwa, nga bwe baali batudde awo, nga banakuwavu, nga bafumiitiriza, era nga basinda. Bayibuli teyogera bw’etyo. Esaasira abonoonyi, naye ebasaasira ng’abajeemu abagudde eddalu era abalina omusango, abalina omusango, era abasaanira okugenda mu ggeyeena, so si ng’abali mu nnaku ab’ennaku abafumiitiriza, abatayinza kukyewala, abaagala okuweebwa obuweerero, naye nga tebalina kye basobola wabula okutuula n’okukungubaga.

2. Okubasabira ng’aboonoonyi ab’ennaku. Bayibuli yali ekozesezza olulimi lwonna ng’olwo? Bayibuli teyogera ku bo nga “aboonoonyi ab’ennaku,” ng’olinga basaanira okusaasirwa okusinga okunenyezebwa. Kristo asaasira abonoonyi mu mutima gwe. Era ne Katonda abasaasira bw’atyo. Awulira mu mutima gwe, okufukumuka kwonna okw’ekisa gye bali, bw’abalaba nga bagenda mu maaso, nga bakakanyavu era nga beekalakaasa mu kwekkusa okwegomba kwabwe, mu kabi ak’obusungu bwe obutaggwaawo. Naye taleka kigambo kyonna kumuvaamu, ng’olinga omwonoonyi “kitonde kya nnaku” bunnaku eky’okusaasirwa, ng’olinga tasobola kukyewala. Endowooza nti wa nnaku, okusinga omubi, atalina mukisa, okusinga alina omusango, ewummuza nnyo omwonoonyi. Ndabye omwonoonyi ng’ayenyoola n’obulumi wansi w’amazima, mu lukuŋŋaana, okutuusa omuntu omu lwe yatandika okumusabira ng’ekitonde eky’ennaku. Era awo n’ayiwa amaziga, n’akaaba nnyo, n’alowooza nti yali ayambiddwa nnyo okusaba ng’okwo. “Ayi, nga kwali kusaba kulungi.” Bw’ogenda kaakano n’oyogera n’omwonoonyi oyo, ojja kusanga nti yeesaasira ng’ekitonde eky’ennaku ekitalina mukisa, oboolyawo ng’akaabira embeera ye etali ya ssanyu, naye OKUSALIRWA OMUSANGO KWE OLW’EKIBI, endowooza ze ez’omunda ennyo ez’OMUSANGO OGW’ENTIISA, byonna biweddewo.

3. Okusaba Katonda ayambe omwonoonyi okwenenya. “Ayi Mukama, sobozesa omwonoonyi ono ow’ennaku okwenenya kaakano.” Kino kireeta mu birowoozo by’omwonoonyi endowooza, nti kaakano agezaako n’amaanyi ge gonna okwenenya, era nti tasobola kukikola, era n’olwekyo Abakristaayo bakoowoola Katonda amuyambe, era amusobozese okukikola. Abeeyita ba ddiini abasinga obungi basabira abonoonyi, si nti Katonda abafuule ABEETEGEFU okwenenya, wabula nti ABASOBOZESE, oba abafuule abasobola. Si kya kwewuunya nti okusaba kwabwe tekuwulirwa. Baggya ku mwonoonyi okuwulira obuvunaanyizibwa bwe, era ekyo ne kiggyawo obuyinike bwe. Naye kuvvoola Katonda, ng’olinga Katonda yalagira omwonoonyi okukola ky’atasobola kukola.

4. Abantu oluusi basaba nti: “Mukama, aboonoonyi bano bakunoonya nga beeraliikirivu.” Olulimi luno lusonga ku ekyo ekyaliwo mu kiseera Yesu bwe yali omulenzi omuto, n’agenda mu yeekaalu okwogera n’abayigiriza b’amateeka n’abakugu. Bazadde be, mujjukira, baatambula olugendo lw’olunaku lumu nga baddayo ewaka, nga tebannakizuula nti tebali naye, awo ne bakyuka ne baddayo, era oluvannyuma lw’okunoonya wonna wonna, ne basanga Yesu omuto ng’ayimiridde mu yeekaalu ng’awakana n’abasajja abayivu, nnyina n’amugamba nti, “Mwana waffe otukoze ki kino? Kitaawo nange tweraliikiridde nnyo nga tukunoonya!” Bwe kityo okusaba kuno kulaga abonoonyi nga banoonya Yesu, naye n’abeekweka, ne banoonya wonna wonna, ne bayigga, ne bagezaako okumuzuula, ne beewuunya Yesu gy’ali, ne bagamba nti, “Mukama, tunoonyezza Yesu ennaku zino essatu nga tweraliikiridde.” Kya BULIMBA. Tewali mwonoonyi yali anoonyezza Yesu n’omutima gwe gwonna ennaku ssatu, oba eddakiika ssatu, n’atasobola kumuzuula. Yesu ayimiridde awo ku mulyango gwe n’akonkona, ali awo ddala mu maaso ge ng’amwegayirira, era ng’amuwakanya mu maaso n’okwefuula kwe kwonna okw’obulimba. Okumunoonya! Omwonoonyi ayinza okwemulugunya n’okukaaba nti, “Ayi, nga bwe ndi mu nnaku, era nga nnoonya Yesu.” Tekiri bwe kityo; Yesu y’akunoonya. Naye ate emitima emeka egibalamula eginyigiriziddwa gibudaabudibwa ne giwummula nga giwulira okumu ku kusaba kuno.

5. “Mukama, saasira aboonoonyi bano, abanoonya okumanya okwagala kwo.” Kino kigambo ekyagalibwa ennyo bangi, ng’olinga abonoonyi banoonya okumanya okwagala kwa Kristo, ne batasobola. Tekiri bwe kityo. Tebanoonya kwagala kwa Kristo, wabula banoonya okutuuka mu ggulu awatali Yesu Kristo. Ng’olinga banoonya okwo, naye ye n’aba mukakanyavu w’omutima nnyo nti teyandibakkirizza kukufuna.

6. “Mukama, saasira emyoyo gino egyenenyezza;” nga bayita abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu emyoyo egyenenyezza. Bwe baba nga beenenyezza, Bakristaayo. Okuleeta ku mwonoonyi atakyuse endowooza nti yeenenyezza, kwe kumukkirizisa obulimba. Naye kibudaabuda nnyo omwonoonyi, era ayagala okukikwata, n’okukisaba nate, “Ayi Mukama, ndi mwoyo gwa nnaku ogwenenyezza, nneenenyezza nnyo, ndi mu buyinike bungi, Mukama saasira omwenenya ow’ennaku.” Kwerimba kwa ntiisa!

7. Oluusi abantu basabira abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu ng’emyoyo emiwombeefu. “Ayi Mukama, aboonoonyi bano beetoowazza.” Lwaki, ekyo si kya mazima, tebeetoowazza; singa beetoowaza, Mukama yandibayimusizza n’abasanyusa, nga bwe yasuubiza. Waliwo oluyimba olw’engeri eno, olukoze obubi bungi. Lutandika,

“Jjangu, mwonoonyi OMUWOMBEEFU, ali n’ekifuba

Ebirowoozo lukumi mwe byetooloolera.”

Oluyimba luno lumu lwaweebwa omubuulizi omu eri omwonoonyi azuukusiddwa, ng’olukwatagana n’embeera ye. N’atandika okusoma, “Jjangu, mwonoonyi omuwombeefu.” N’ayimirira, “Mwonoonyi omuwombeefu, ekyo tekikwatagana nange, siri mwonoonyi muwombeefu.” Ah, nga kyali kirungi nnyo gy’ali nti Mwoyo Mutukuvu yali amuyigirizza obulungi okusinga oluyimba. Singa oluyimba lwagamba nti, Jjangu, mwonoonyi omweraliikirivu, oba mwonoonyi alina omusango, oba mwonoonyi akankana, kyandibadde kirungi ekimala, naye okumuyita mwonoonyi omuwombeefu tekyandisaanidde. Waliwo ennyimba nnyingi nnyo ez’engeri y’emu. Kitera nnyo okusanga abonoonyi nga bajuliza endowooza ez’obulimba ez’oluyimba olumu, okwewolereza mu bujeemu eri Katonda.

Omubuulizi omu yaŋŋamba nti yawulira okusaba, mu biseera bino ddala, mu bigambo bino, “Ayi Mukama, aboonoonyi bano beetoowazza, era bazze gy’oli nga bwe bamanyi. Singa bamanyi ekisinga, bandikoze ekisinga, naye Ayi Mukama, nga bwe bazze gy’oli, mu ngeri esinga obulungi gye basobola, tukwegayiridde obakkirize era obalage okusaasira.” Kya ntiisa!

8. Bangi basaba nti, “Kitange, basonyiwe, kubanga kye bakola tebakimanyi.” Kuno kwe kusaba Kristo kwe yasabira abaamutta. Era, mu mbeera eyo, kyali kya mazima, tebaamanya kye baali bakola, kubanga tebaakkiriza nti Yesu Kristo ye Masiya. Naye tekiyinza kwogerwa ku boonoonyi abali wansi w’Enjiri, nti tebamanyi kye bakola. Bamanyi kye bakola. Tebalaba bunene bwakyo bwonna, naye bamanyi nti bayonoona eri Katonda, era nti bagaana Kristo, era obuzibu buli nti, tebaagala kugondera Katonda. Naye okusaba ng’okwo kuteekeddwateekeddwa okumuleetera okuwulira ng’awummudde, n’okumuleetera okugamba nti, “Mukama, oyinza otya okunvunaana bw’otyo, ndi kitonde kya nnaku ekitamanyi, simanyi ngeri ya kukola ekyo kye ndagirwa. Singa nnamanya engeri, nandikikoze.”

9. Ekigambo ekirala kiri nti, “Mukama, lung’amya aboonoonyi bano, ababuuza ekkubo erigenda e Sayuuni, nga batunuulidde eyo.” Naye olulimi luno lukwatagana n’Abakristaayo bokka. Abonoonyi tebatunuulidde Sayuuni, amaaso gaabwe gatunuulidde ggeyeena. Era omwonoonyi ayinza atya okwogerwako nti “abuuza ekkubo” erigenda e Sayuuni, nga talina kwagala kwonna kugendayo. Obuzibu obw’amazima buli nti, tayagala KUTAMBULIRA mu kkubo ly’amanyi nti asaanidde okugendamu.

10. Abantu basaba abonoonyi basalirwe omusango mu mutima okusingawo. Oba, basaba abonoonyi baddeyo eka nga basirifu era nga bagonvu, ne bafumiitiriza ku nsonga, mu kifo ky’okusaba beenenye kaakano. Oba, basaba ng’olinga balowooza nti omwonoonyi mwetegefu okukola ekyo ekyetaagibwa. Okusaba ng’okwo kwonna, kwe kusaba kwennyini Setaani kw’ayagala. Ayagala okubeera n’okusaba ng’okwo, era nneetantala okugamba nti tafaayo na bunene bw’okwo okuweebwayo.

Oluusi ndabye mu lukuŋŋaana lw’abeeraliikirivu, oba abonoonyi bwe bayitiddwa okujja ku ntebe z’abeeraliikirivu, n’omubuulizi n’afuula ekkubo ly’obulokozi lyonna eryangu gye bali, n’aggyawo ebyesittaza byonna mu kkubo lyabwe, n’aggyawo ekizikiza ky’ebirowoozo byabwe ku nsonga ez’enjawulo, era nga bali kumpi okuGONDA, omuntu omu n’ayitibwa okusaba, era mu kifo ky’okusaba beenenye kaakano, n’atandika okusaba nti, “Ayi Mukama, tukwegayiridde, aboonoonyi bano babeere basirifu, babeere n’okutegeera okw’omunda ennyo okw’obwonoonyi bwabwe, baddeyo eka nga bakwatiddwako embeera yaabwe ey’okubula, baleme kugezaako kintu kyonna mu maanyi gaabwe bokka, baleme kufiirwa kusalirwa kwabwe omusango mu mutima, era nti, mu kiseera kyo ne mu ngeri yo, baleetebwe mu kitangaala eky’ekitiibwa n’eddembe ly’abaana ba Katonda.”

Mu kifo ky’okubaleeta ddala ku nsonga ey’okugonda AMANGU DDALA, mu kifo ekyo, kibawa obudde okussa omukka, kiggyawo okunyigirizibwa kwonna okw’okusalirwa omusango mu mutima, era n’assa omukka nate mu ddembe n’awulira ng’awummudde, n’atuula mu mirembe. Bwe kityo, omwonoonyi bw’aleetebwa, ng’olinga, n’ayimirira ku mulyango gw’eggulu, okusaba ng’okwo, mu kifo ky’okumusindika munda, kumuzzaayo emabega nate,—“Wuuyo, ow’ennaku, tuula awo okutuusa Katonda lw’anaakuyamba.”

11. Abakristaayo oluusi basaba mu ngeri ereeta endowooza nti KRISTO YE MUKWANO GW’OMWONOONYI, mu makulu ag’enjawulo ku ga Katonda Kitaffe. Bamusaba nti, “Ayi, ggwe mukwano gw’aboonoonyi,” ng’olinga Katonda ajjudde obusungu, n’okwesasuza okukambwe, ng’agenda kubetenta omunaku, okutuusa Yesu Kristo lw’ajja n’amuwagira, n’amununula. Kaakano kino kyonna kikyamu. Kitaffe n’Omwana bakkiriziganya ddala, enneewulira zaabwe zonna ze zimu, era bombi baagala kye kimu abonoonyi okulokolebwa. Era okuleeta endowooza ng’eyo, kulimba omwonoonyi, era kuleeta enneewulira enkyamu eri Katonda. Okulaga Katonda Kitaffe ng’ayimiridde waggulu we, n’ekitala eky’obwenkanya mu mukono gwe, ng’ayagala nnyo okukuba, okutuusa Kristo lw’ayingira wakati, si kya mazima. Kitaffe mukwano gw’omwonoonyi nga Omwana bw’ali. Ekisa kye kyenkana. Naye omwonoonyi bw’afuna endowooza eno embi ku Katonda Kitaffe, anaamwagala atya n’omutima gwe gwonna, okutuusa okugamba nti “Aba, Kitaffe.”

12. Endowooza etera okuleetebwa olw’engeri y’okusaba, nti temusuubira abonoonyi kwenenya KAAKANO, oba nti musuubira Katonda okukola omulimu GWABWE, oba nti mwagala okubazzaamu amaanyi okwesiga okusaba kwammwe. Bwe batyo, abonoonyi bazikirizibwa. Temusabanga mu ngeri ereeta ku boonoonyi endowooza, nti mu kyama musuubira nti Bakristaayo dda, oba nti mulina obwesige obw’amaanyi nti balibeera, mu bbanga, oba nti mukkiriza kitundu nti bakyuse kaakano. Kino bulijjo kiba kya nnaku. Bangi nnyo balimbibwa n’okubudaabudibwa okw’obulimba, mu ngeri eno, ne baziyizibwa, ddala ku nsonga enkulu, okwewaayo okusembayo eri Katonda.

Baganda bange, nzudde ennimiro eno ngazi nnyo nti siyinza n’akatono kwogera byonna bye nnayagala okwogera. Waliwo ebintu ebirala bingi bye nnali ngenderera okukwatako akawungeezi kano, naye obudde buyise nnyo. Nnina okufundikira n’ebigambo ebimpi ebitono

EBIGAMBO EBY’OKUFUNDIKIRA.

1. Abantu bangi abakolagana mu ngeri eno n’abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu, bakikola olw’okusaasira okw’obulimba. Bawulira okusaasira n’ekisa kingi nnyo nti tebasobola kugumira kubabuulira mazima, agetaagisa okubalokola. Kyandibadde kye kimu omusawo omulongoosa, bw’alaba nti omukono gw’omuntu gulina okusalibwako, oba ajja kufa, okwekkiriza enneewulira eno ey’okusaasira okw’obulimba, n’ateekako bussi ekiwero, n’amuwa eddagala erimweebasa. Tewali kisa mu ekyo. Ekisa eky’amazima kyandireetedde omusawo omulongoosa okukweka enneewulira ze, n’okuba omukkakkamu era omuteefu, era n’akambe ak’obwogi, n’asalako ekitundu ky’omubiri, n’awonya obulamu. Kuba kukwatibwa kisa kwa bulimba okukola ekintu kyonna ekitono ku ekyo. Lumu nnalaba omukazi ali mu buyinike bw’ebirowoozo, eyali kumpi okusindikibwa mu kuggwaamu essuubi okumala emyezi. Mikwano gye baali bagezezzaako okubudaabuda kuno kwonna okw’obulimba awatali kivaamu, ne bamuleeta okulaba omubuulizi, Yali akozze, era ng’akooye olw’obulumi. Omubuulizi n’amusimbako eriiso, n’afuka amazima ku birowoozo bye, n’amunenya mu ngeri esinga obusongovu. Omukazi eyali naye n’ayingira mu nsonga, yalowooza nti bwali bukambwe, n’agamba nti, “Ayi, mubudaabude, ali mu buyinike bungi, tomutawaanya nate, tasobola kukigumira.” N’akyuka, n’amunenya ye, n’amugoba, era awo n’afuka amazima ku mwonoonyi omweraliikirivu ng’omuliro, era mu ddakiika ttaano n’akyuka, n’addayo eka ng’ajjudde essanyu. Amazima amangu gaayera endowooza ze zonna ez’obulimba, era mu kaseera katono n’aba musanyufu mu Katonda.

2. Engeri eno ey’okukolagana n’abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu, ey’okubawa okubudaabudibwa okw’obulimba, mu butuufu, bukambwe. Bukambwe ng’entaana, bukambwe nga ggeyeena, kubanga buteekeddwateekeddwa okusindika omwonoonyi wansi mu bunnya bwayo obwaka. Abakristaayo bawulira ekisa eri abeeraliikirivu, era bwe batyo bwe basaanidde. Naye ekintu ekisembayo kye basaanidde okukola, kwe kudda emabega ddala ku nsonga w’etuukira ku kisa ekisalawo. Basaanidde okuwulira ekisa, naye basaanidde okukiraga ddala ng’omusawo omulongoosa bw’akola, bw’agenda ku mulimu mu bwegendereza, mu ngeri entuufu era esinga obulungi, n’asalako omukono gw’omuntu, bw’atyo n’amuwonya n’awonya obulamu bwe. Bwe kityo Abakristaayo basaanidde okuleka omwonoonyi alabe ekisa kyabwe n’obugonvu bwabwe, naye basaanidde okuwagira oludda lwa Katonda, mu bujjuvu era mu bunywevu. Basaanidde okubikkulira omwonoonyi, embeera ye esinga obubi, okwanika omusango gwe n’akabi ke, ate oluvannyuma ne bamukulembera ddala okutuuka ku musalaba, ne bakakaatika ku kugonda amangu ddala. Balina okubeera n’obunywevu obumala okukola omulimu guno mu bujjuvu, era bwe balaba omwonoonyi ng’ali mu buyinike ne mu bulumi, balina naye okumunyigiriza ddala mu maaso, ne batadda emabega n’akatono, ne bw’aba mu bulumi bwenkana wa, naye ne beeyongera okunyigiriza okutuusa lw’anaagonda.

Okukola kino emirundi mingi kyetaagisa obuvumu. Emirundi mingi nteekeddwa mu mbeera, okumanya kino olw’obumanyirivu. Nneesanze nga nneetooloddwa abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu, abali mu buyinike obwenkanidde awo, okukankanya buli musuwa, abamu nga bawanguddwa enneewulira era nga bagalamidde wansi, abamu nga basiigibwa kafulu okubaziyiza okuzirika, abalala nga bakuba ebiwoobe ng’olinga bali kumpi okugenda mu ggeyeena. Kaakano, ka tugambe omuntu yenna yandiwadde okubudaabudibwa okw’obulimba mu mbeera ng’eno. Ka tugambe teyalina buvumu bumala okubaleeta ddala ku nsonga ey’okugonda amangu ddala era okujjuvu. Omusajja ng’oyo nga tasaanira kwesigibwa mu mbeera ng’eno.

3. Oluusi abonoonyi bagwa eddalu olw’okuggwaamu essuubi n’obulumi bw’ebirowoozo. Kino bwe kiba bwe kityo, kumpi bulijjo kiba kubanga abo abakolagana nabo bagezaako okubazzaamu amaanyi n’okubudaabuda okw’obulimba, bwe batyo ne babaleeta mu kulwanagana ng’okwo ne Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Bagezaako okubawanirira, nga Katonda agezaako okubamenya. Era mu bbanga, ebirowoozo by’omwonoonyi bitabuka olw’amaanyi gano agakontana, era oba agwa eddalu, oba asindikibwa mu kuggwaamu essuubi.

4. Bw’oba ogenda okukolagana n’abonoonyi, jjukira nti mangu ddala ojja kubasisinkana mu musango, era okakase okubakwata mu ngeri nti bwe banaabula, kiriba nsobi yaabwe bo. Togezaako kubabudaabuda n’endowooza ez’obulimba kaakano, ne bakulumiriza olw’ekyo olwo. Kisinga okuziyiza okusaasira kwo okw’obulimba, n’oleka amazima ag’obwereere gabayuze, ennyingo n’obusomyo, okusinga okubakkakkanya n’okubudaabuda okw’obulimba, n’okubasendasenda okuva ku Katonda.

4. Mwonoonyi! bw’oyogera n’Abakristaayo bonna, ne bakugamba okukola ekintu kyonna, sooka obuuze nti, “Bwe nnaakola ekyo, ndirokolebwa?” Oyinza okuba omweraliikirivu, n’otalokolebwa. Oyinza okusaba, n’otalokolebwa. Oyinza okusoma Bayibuli yo, n’otalokolebwa. Oyinza okukozesa engeri ezaateekebwawo, mu ngeri yo, n’otalokolebwa. Kyonna kye bakugamba okukola, bw’oba ng’osobola okukikola n’otalokolebwa, tofaayo ku kuyigiriza ng’okwo. Kuteekeddwateekeddwa okukuwa okubudaabudibwa okw’obulimba, n’okuwugula okufaayo kwo okuva ku kintu ekikulu ekirina okukolebwa, n’okukusendasenda okukka mu ggeyeena. Togoberera biragiro ng’ebyo byonna, oleme kufa ng’okikola, era olwo tewali kuddamu kugezaako.

Ekisembayo, togambanga mwonoonyi kintu kyonna, oba okumuwa ekiragiro kyonna, ekinaamuleetera okuyimirira nga tannatuuka, oba ekitazingiramu kugondera Katonda mu bujjuvu. Okumuleka okuyimirira ku nsonga yonna etannatuuka ku kino, kya kabi mu ngeri etaliiko kkomo. Ka tugambe oli mu lukuŋŋaana lw’abeeraliikirivu, oba mu lukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba, n’ogamba omwonoonyi okusaba, oba okusoma ekitabo, oba ekintu kyonna ekitono ku kwenenya okulokola, n’agwa n’amenyeka ensingo ekiro ekyo, omusaayi gwe gwandibuuziddwa ku ani? Omuvubuka omu mu New England lumu yasisinkana omubuulizi mu luguudo, n’amubuuza ky’alina okukola okulokolebwa. Omubuulizi n’amugamba agende eka ayingire mu kisenge kye, afukamire awe Katonda omutima gwe. “Ayi, ssebo,” omulenzi bwe yagamba, “mpulira bubi nnyo, ntya nti sijja kuba mulamu kutuuka waka.” Omubuulizi n’alaba ensobi ye, n’awulira okunenya, okwaweebwa bwe kutyo omwana nga tamanyi, n’amugamba nti, “Kale, olwo, wa Katonda omutima gwo wano, era genda eka mu kisenge kyo omubuulire.”

Ayi, kimala okuleetera omutima gw’omuntu okuvaamu omusaayi, okulaba ababudaabuzi ab’ennaku bangi bwe batyo eri abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu, mu bye baddamu temusigaddemu wabula obulimba. Nga waliwo obulimba bungi nnyo obw’abasawo b’omwoyo abatali ba mazima mu nsi, era nga waliwo bameka “abagunja eby’obulimba,” “abasawo abatagasa,” abatamanyi kirala okuggyako okubudaabuda abonoonyi n’essuubi ery’obulimba, n’okubalimba n’“enfumo zaabwe ezitaliimu,” n’ebitaliimu makulu, oba abeewaayo eri obugonvu n’okusaasira okw’obulimba, okutuusa lwe batalina bunywevu bumala okulaba ekitala ky’Omwoyo nga kikozesebwa, okusala abantu okutuuka mu mmeeme, n’okubikkula omutima gw’omwonoonyi omwereere. Woowe! nti bangi bwe batyo bateekebwa mu buweereza, abatalina bukugu bumala okuyimirira ku mabbali ne balaba Omwoyo wa Katonda ng’akola omulimu gwe, mu kumenya emisingi emikadde, n’okubetenta essuubi lyonna erivunze ery’omwonoonyi, n’okumumenya wonna ku bigere bya Yesu.

fields.title: Omusomo XVIII. Ebiragiro eri Abonoonyi
fields.body_html:
OMUSOMO XVIII.

EBIRAGIRO ERI ABONOONYI.

Ekyawandiikibwa—“Bassebo, nkole ki okulokolebwa?”—Ebikolwa 16:30.

BINO bye bigambo by’omukuumi w’ekkomera e Firipi, ekibuuzo kye yabuuza Pawulo ne Siira, abaali mu mikono gye ng’abasibe. Setaani yali, mu ngeri nnyingi, awakanyizza abaweereza ba Katonda bano mu mulimu gwabwe ogw’okubuulira Enjiri, era yali awanguddwa era aswaziddwa emirundi gyenkana awo. Naye wano, e Firipi, yateekateeka enkwe empya era ey’enjawulo ey’okulemesa emirimu gyabwe. Waaliwo omukazi omu e Firipi, eyaliko omwoyo gw’obulaguzi, oba mu bigambo ebirala, omwoyo gwa Setaani, era eyaleeteranga bakama be amagoba mangi olw’obulaguzi bwe. Setaani yateeka omukazi ono okugobereranga Pawulo ne Siira mu nguudo, era amangu ddala nga batandise okufuna okufaayo kw’abantu, yajjanga n’aleekaana nti, “Bano baddu ba Katonda Ali Waggulu Ennyo, era babategeeza ekkubo ly’obulokozi.” Kwe kugamba, yatandika okuwagira okubuulirira kw’ababuulizi, n’ayongerako obujulizi bwe, ng’olinga awa amaanyi agasingawo eri okuyigiriza kwabwe. Ekyavaamu kyali kyennyini Setaani kye yayagala. Abantu bonna baali bamanyi nti ono yali mukazi mubi, ow’ekivve, era bwe baamuwulira ng’agezaako okusiima okubuulira kuno okuggya, ne batama, ne basalawo nti byonna bya kika kimu. Setaani yali amanyi nti tekyandimugasizza, wabula kyandiyambye ensonga yaabwe, okuteeka omuntu ng’oyo okuwakanya okubuulira kw’abatume, oba okukwogerako obubi. Ekiseera kyali kiyise, ekyo okuwangula. Era, n’olwekyo, ajja mu ludda olulala, n’akwata ekkubo ekikontana, era bwe yamuteeka okubatendereza ng’abaweereza ba Katonda, n’okuwa obujulizi bwe obw’obugwagwa okuwagira okuyigiriza kwabwe, yaleetera abantu okulowooza nti abatume baali ba mpisa y’emu naye, era nti baalina omwoyo gwe gumu gwe yalina, era bwe gutyo okufuba kwabwe kwonna ne kuwangulwa. Pawulo n’alaba nti ebintu bwe byandigenze mu maaso bwe bityo, yandisobeddwa ddala, era teyandiwangudde mu kutandikawo kkanisa e Firipi. N’amukyukira, n’alagira omwoyo omubi, mu linnya lya Yesu Kristo, okumuvaamu. Bakama be bwe baalaba nti essuubi ly’amagoba gaabwe liweddewo, ne baleeta okuyigganya okunene, ne bakwata Pawulo ne Siira, ne bakuba enduulu nnyingi, ne babaleeta mu maaso g’abalamuzi, ne baleeta oluyoogaano olwenkanidde awo nti abalamuzi ne babasibira mu kkomera, ne basiba ebigere byabwe mu nvuba.

Bwe batyo, baalowooza nti bazikizza akasattiro. Naye mu ttumbi Pawulo ne Siira ne basaba ne bayimba ennyimba ez’okutendereza, n’abasibe ne babawulira. Ekkomera lino ekkadde eryali limaze ebbanga eddene nga liddamu eddoboozi ly’okuvvoola n’ebirayiro, kaakano ne liddamu ennyimba ez’okutendereza Katonda, n’ebisenge bino, ebyali biyimiridde nga binywevu bwe bityo, kaakano ne bikankana wansi w’amaanyi g’okusaba. Envuba ne zisumululwa, enzigi ne zigguka, era buli muntu enjegere ze ne zimenyeka. Omukuumi w’ekkomera n’azuukuka mu tulo twe, era bwe yalaba enzigi z’ekkomera nga nziggule, olw’okuba yali amanyi nti abasibe bwe bandibadde badduse yandisasudde n’obulamu bwe, n’asowola ekitala kye, era yali agenda kwetta. Naye Pawulo, ataalina kirowoozo kya kudduka mu kyama, n’amukoowoola amangu ddala nti, “Teweekola kabi, kubanga ffenna tuli wano.” Omukuumi w’ekkomera n’asaba ettaala, n’abuukira munda, n’ajja ng’akankana, n’agwa wansi mu maaso g’abasibe be, Pawulo ne Siira, n’abafulumya, n’agamba nti, “Bassebo, nkole ki okulokolebwa?”

Mu musomo gwange ogwasembayo, nnayogera mu bugazi ku kuyigiriza okw’obulimba okuweebwa abonoonyi abasaliddwa omusango mu mutima, n’okubudaabuda okw’obulimba okutera ennyo okuweebwa, n’okuyigiriza okukyamu abantu ng’abo kwe bafuna. Ekigendererwa kyange, ekiro kya leero, kwe kulaga okuyigiriza kwe kuliwa okusaanidde okuweebwa abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu olw’okukyuka kwabwe okw’amangu era okukola. Oba, mu bigambo ebirala, okubannyonnyola, okuddamu kwe kuliwa okusaanidde okuweebwa abo ababuuza nti, “Nkole ki okulokolebwa?” Mu kukikola, ngenderera,

I. Okulaga ekitali kiragiro kituufu eky’okuweebwa abonoonyi, bwe babuuza ekibuuzo ekiri mu kyawandiikibwa.

II. Okulaga okuddamu okutuufu eri ekibuuzo. Era,

III. Okwogera ku nsobi eziwerako, abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu ze batera okugwamu.

I. Nnina okulaga ebitali biragiro bituufu eby’okuweebwa abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu.

Tewabangawo kibuuzo kikulu okusinga kino, “Nkole ki okulokolebwa?” Abantu batera nnyo okubuuza nti “Nnaalya ki, era nnaanywa ki,” era ekibuuzo kiyinza okuddibwamu mu ngeri ez’enjawulo, nga waliwo akabi katono. Naye omwonoonyi bw’abuuza mu bunyiikivu nti, “Nkole ki okulokolebwa?” kikulu mu ngeri etaliiko kkomo nti afuna okuddamu okutuufu. Kye njagala, ekiro kya leero, kwe kubabuulira, mmwe abeeyita ba ddiini, eky’okuddamu eri ekibuuzo kino, n’okubabuulira, mmwe aboonoonyi, kye mulina okukola okulokolebwa.

1. Tewali kiragiro kisaanidde kuweebwa mwonoonyi, ekinaamuleka ng’akyali mu kukaawa kw’omutima ne mu busibe bw’obutali butuukirivu. Tewali kuddamu kusaanidde kuweebwa, okwo, bw’akugondera, teyandigenze mu ggulu, singa yandifudde mu kaseera akaddako.

2. Tewali kiragiro kisaanidde kuweebwa, ekitazingiramu kukyuka kwa mutima, oba omutima omutuufu, oba okugondera Kristo n’omutima gwonna. Mu bigambo ebirala, tewali kituufu, ekitategeeza kufuuka ddala Mukristaayo. Ekiragiro kyonna ekitatuuka ku kino, tekirina mugaso. Tekijja kumusembeza ku bwakabaka, tekijja kugasa, naye kijja kumuleetera kyokka okwongezaayo ekintu kyennyini ky’alina okukola, okulokolebwa. Omwonoonyi asaanidde okubuulirwa mu lwatu, amangu ddala, ky’alina okukola, oba afe; era tasaanye kubuulirwa kintu kyonna ekitazingiramu mbeera ntuufu ey’omutima. Kyonna ky’oyinza okukola, mwonoonyi, ekitazingiramu mutima mutuufu, kibi. Ne bw’osoma Bayibuli oba nedda, kibi, nga bw’oba okyali mu bujeemu. Ne bw’ogenda mu lukuŋŋaana, oba n’otagenda, ne bw’osaba oba nedda, si kirala wabula obujeemu, buli kaseera. Kya kwewuunya, omwonoonyi okulowooza nti akolera Katonda obuweereza, bw’asaba, n’asoma Bayibuli ye. Singa omujeemu eri gavumenti eno, asoma ekitabo ky’amateeka, ng’akyeyongera mu bujeemu, era nga talina kigendererwa kya kugonda; singa asaba okusonyiyibwa, ng’akyakutte ebyokulwanyisa bye eby’okuziyiza n’olutalo, wandimulowoozezza ng’akolera ensi ye obuweereza, era ng’abassaako obuvunaanyizibwa okumulaga ekisa? Nedda, wandigambye nti okusoma kwe kwonna n’okusaba, kwali kuvvoola bukulu bw’oyo eyakola amateeka n’amateeka gennyini. Bwe kityo ggwe, mwonoonyi, ng’okyali mu buteenenya, ovvoola Katonda era omusoomooza, ne bw’osoma ekigambo kye n’osaba oba n’obireka. Tekirina mugaso kifo ki oba mbeera ki omubiri gwo mwe guli, ng’ofukamidde, oba mu nnyumba ya Katonda, nga omutima gwo bwe guba si mutuufu, nga bw’oziyiza Mwoyo Mutukuvu, n’ogaana Kristo, oli mujeemu eri Omutonzi wo.

II. Nnina okulaga okuddamu okutuufu eri ekibuuzo kino. “Nkole ki okulokolebwa?”

Era, okutwalira awamu, oyinza okuwa omwonoonyi ekiragiro kyonna, oba okumugamba okukola ekintu kyonna, ekizingiramu omutima omutuufu, era bw’omuleetera okukitegeera, n’akikola, ajja kulokolebwa. Omwoyo wa Katonda, mu kuwakana n’abonoonyi, akwataganya okuwakana kwe n’embeera y’ebirowoozo gy’abasangamu. Ekigendererwa kye ekikulu mu kuwakana nabo, kwe, kubaggya mu bifo byabwe eby’okwekwekamu, n’okubaleeta okugondera Katonda, amangu ddala. Kaakano okuwakanya kuno, n’obuzibu, n’embeera z’ebirowoozo, bya njawulo nga embeera z’abantu bwe ziri, bingi nga abantu kinnoomu bwe bali. Empisa z’abantu kinnoomu ziwa enjawulo etaggwaawo. Ekirina okukolebwa ku buli omu, n’engeri gy’alina okukyusibwamu, byesigama ku nsobi ze ez’enjawulo. Kyetaagisa okuzuula ensobi ze, okumanya by’ategeera, n’ebyo by’ayetaaga okuyigirizibwa obulungi okusingawo, okulaba ensonga ki Omwoyo wa Katonda z’anyigiriza ku mutima gwe ogumulamula, n’okunyigiriza ebintu bye bimu era bwe kityo okumuleeta eri Kristo. Ebiragiro ebisinga okubaawo bye bino:

1. Okutwalira awamu kituukirawo, era kiragiro kya bukuumi era ekisaanira, okugamba omwonoonyi okwenenya. Ŋŋamba nti, okutwalira awamu. Kubanga oluusi Omwoyo wa Katonda alabika ng’atalung’amya nnyo kufaayo kw’omwonoonyi eri ebibi bye okusinga eri ekintu ekirala. Mu biseera by’abatume, ebirowoozo by’abantu birabika okuba nga byasasamazibwa nnyo ekibuuzo, oba Yesu ye yali Masiya ow’amazima. Era bwe batyo abatume baalung’amya okuyigiriza kwabwe kungi ku nsonga eno, okukakasa nti ye yali Kristo. Era buli abonoonyi abeeraliikirivu lwe baababuuzanga kye balina okukola, emirundi egisinga baabakubirizanga nti “Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu.” Baanyigirizanga ku nsonga eno, kubanga wano Omwoyo wa Katonda we yali awakaniranga nabo, era eno ye yali ensonga eyasinga okusasamaza ebirowoozo by’abantu, era, n’olwekyo, kino oboolyawo kye kyandibadde ekintu ekisooka omuntu ky’akola ng’agondera Katonda. Yali nsonga enkulu ey’empaka wakati wa Katonda n’Omuyudaaya n’Omumawanga ow’ennaku ezo, oba Yesu Kristo ye yali Omwana wa Katonda. Ye yali ensonga ey’okukaayanirwa. Okuleeta omwonoonyi okukkiriza ekibuuzo kino ekyakaayanirwa, lye kkubo eryasinga okumutoowaza.

Mu biseera ebirala, kijja kuzuulibwa, nti Omwoyo wa Katonda akolagana n’abonoonyi okusinga ku bikwata ku bibi byabwe. Oluusi akolagana nabo ku bikwata ku mulimu ogw’enjawulo, ng’okusaba, oboolyawo okusaba kw’amaka. Omwonoonyi ajja kuzuulibwa ng’awakana ne Katonda ku nsonga eyo, oba kituufu ye okusaba, oba asaanidde okusabira mu maka ge.
